description: Come stay in this private, quiet and homely home, it is located in the heart of downtown. This house is perfect for a group of travel companions or a family looking for a peaceful stay. Enjoy walking everywhere in this apartment in the heart of Istanbul. Our house is centrally located to many restaurants and shopping. Amenities include High Speed Wi-Fi, Fully equipped kitchen - Washing machine and dryer.

reviews.text: My stay at this Mesut was fantastic! The place was very clean and exactly as pictured. Mesut was responsive, communicative, and always there when needed. The location was really convenient, right in the centre of all the shops and designers clothes, yet it was quiet. The WiFi worked great, and all the amenities were in order and working well. The best part of the stay was the location and the size of the apprtment, which was incredibly good value for the price. I would definitely recommend it and give it 5 stars!

BLACK MOLD!!!!
I work in healthcare, and noticed the strange smell coming from the bathroom. Looking through the bathroom, besides the utter dirtiness, there was BLACK MOLD in the washing machine. Which I noticed after trying to use it, and it leaking all over the bathroom. I informed the host he told me he could look at it the next day.
Besides the fact of the host being very rude, making false accusations of us leaving the unit in a mess. When in fact, we washed all the dishes, cleaned everything and made up the beds (I took pictures). He then proceeded to mess up the beds and living area to make it seem like we left the place in a mess.
I did not want to stay in a unit with BLACK MOLD, that was also disgustingly dirty. So I informed the host that I wanted to leave. He refused to refund anything.
I then informed Airbnb of this, and provided them with PHOTO evidence of the dirtiness and the BLACK MOLD. They told me that they could not do anything except refund me about 20%.

Mesut's place was really spacious, clean, and cozy. The flat is big, it has two bedrooms and a living room. The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay: AC, washing and drying machines, a hair dryer, an iron, a dishwasher, household utensils and cable TV. Mesut was fast in responding to my messages and addressing all my requests. He is a very responsible host who tried to help me as much as needed to make my stay enjoyable. The flat is located just 4 minutes away from the Osmanbey metro station and 4 minutes away from all the shops and cafes of the Nişantaşı area.
Manu thanks to Mesut for his hospitality and kindness. Highly recommended.

Perfect location very close to shops and anything you could need on your travels. Spacious and comfortable living space, kitchen had everything I needed to cook and the host was especially communicative, friendly and helpful. The interior design of this apartment that the host has put together for your stay is beautiful! Can’t recommend enough

"Great stay in a convenient location!
The apartment is in a good area, about a 10-minute walk to Osmanbey metro station, and close to shops and restaurants. Everything was as expected and comfortable. Mesut is very supportive and responds quickly to any questions. When there was a city water cut-off in Istanbul, he quickly arranged and sent us plenty of drinking water to the apartment, which we really appreciated. The kitchen is well equipped, although the mattress could be a bit more comfortable. Overall, I am very satisfied with my stay and would come again. Highly recommended!"

description: The apartment is a 5-minute walk from the metro, tram and ferry stations. It is the perfect place for those who want to visit the best sights of Istanbul. It is located on the first floor and a sea view. The neighborhood is close to most of the tourist attractions. By walking Dolmabahce Palace & Museum of Painting and Sculpture and Galataport Shopping mall by the Bosphorus are easy to access. By tram, you can go to Old City (Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque and Topkapi Palace area) in 10 min.

reviews.text:
Superb airbnb in Istanbul:
-Fantastic location. Walking distance to bus, trams terminals to Sultanahmet, Kabatas pier to Kadikoy, a leisurely easy walk to the elegent neighbourhood of Ortakoy.
-Dolmabahce Palace Museum & Mosque is diagonally across.
-Beautiful view of Bosphorus fr the living room.
-Quiet, clean & a well-equpped kitchen.
-the host Mr Bahadir is simply awesome. I left my jacket behind in Cappadocia & the hotel there could not find a solution to send the jacket to me. Mr Bahadir stepped in on his own initiative, contacted the hotel, made many calls back & forth, told the hotel to put the jacket on an overnight bus, so that it can get to Istanbul in the morn, co-ordinate wt the bus driver on the time & bus station in Istanbul to meet up, picked up the jacket & brought it to me just before I have to leave for the airport for my flight home. He is an amazing 10*host! He did all this for just a jacket, AND you know you are in safe hands! I'm definitely coming back!

As a mobility-limited family, within VERY hilly Istanbul, Gamze's apartment was a PERFECT location -- right on the Bosphorus with excellent public transportation options (tram, metro, buses and ferries) all immediately accessible (within 300 meters -- all flat). The apartment is on the first floor of a lovely building with about eight stairs to climb from the building's entrance door. The large, two bedroom apartment is very well laid out with a modern, stylish kitchen and dining/living area. The view is absolutely fabulous and not too noisy due to high quality windows. Gamze was a fantastic host, always response and supportive. Bottom line -- we loved this place and we will definitely be back!

I really liked everything, thank to the host for being kind and easy to communicate with. He helped us with early access to the house . He arranged a taxi for the airport. The place is suitable for elderly people. Although it was on little cliff but mum can walk . You can find everything you need inside the house. I really felt like my home.The location and the view were more than perfect. It is near to Kabataş Tran ,The underground that took you to Taksim meydan & different places Osama bay, Mecidiyeköy,şişli
Adal Rahman and his wife Hajar were kind and friendly. They cleaned the house quickly & helped me find out the market.There is only one thing I wish if you put a door for the bathroom in the second bedroom & a curtain in the kitchen window . I recommends the house and am going to stay for another time . Her şey için teşekkür ederim gerçekten çok güzel bir tatil sağ ol.

Gamze's and Bahadir's appartement is really wonderful - spotless clean, well equipped and very well maintained. It's very cosy with lots of books and pictures on the walls and a wonderful view of the Bosphorus. Communication with Bahadir was very easy and he was always very quick to respond and the nicest person to talk to.
However we were not so happy with the location: As others pointed out it is rather central with all means of public transport nearby - but it's also located next to one of the busiest streets with heavy traffic noise during the day. If you spend the day out exploring the city and come back after dinner, you'll probably be fine, as the traffic calms down during the night. But if you plan to spend more time inside to take a break or to work - just be prepared, that it can be noisy.

Our stay was Fantastic 💖
The house has modern design and a fully equipped kitchen, which was great for cooking. The location was ideal; the window view was amazing and very easy access to transport like tram and bus. Check-in was smooth with clear instructions and the space was generally clean. Overall, a good value for money and a pleasant stay..

Thank you for your kind words! It was a pleasure staying at your apartment. I'm glad I could meet your expectations and would love to stay again in the future. Your hospitality made my trip even better!

description:
The entire apartment is clean and well-maintained that cannot be found in a historical apartment in Istanbul.
Although it is located in a lively part of the city like Beyoğlu, it is in a quiet neighborhood.
The apartment is delivered to each guest cleaned and with new sheets and towels.
Places such as Asmalı Mescit, Istiklal Street and Galata Tower are within a 10-minute walk. Nişantaşı,Sultanahmet are easily reached by nearby public transportation.

reviews.text:
My family and I ( 4 adults ) had a great and comfortable time at the apartment which was located at a good walkable distance from different bus stops and istiklal st., it was pretty easy to locate as long as you follow the location/address. Before we arrived i asked if it was possible to check in earlier and thankfully Gulfem informed me that the apartment was available and ready, it was clean and tidy as shown in the photos, all amenities mentioned were available and functional. You can easily find small shops located close by, so it is easy to buy your needs as you go back after a long day.
Only thing to keep in mind as also mentioned is that there is no elevator in the building and you would have to haul luggages up to the 4th floor (travel light haha). Our Host Gulfem was also very helpful and responsive.

We had an outstanding stay at Goflem’s apartment. Everything was exactly as shown in the photo, beautiful, clean, and fully equipped with everything we needed. Nothing was missing, which made our stay very comfortable over the nearly four weeks we were there.
Goflem was an exceptional host—extremely responsive, helpful, and always available when needed. She even went the extra mile on our last day by arranging assistance with our luggage, which we truly appreciated.
This has been one of the best Airbnb experiences we’ve ever had. Thank you so much, Goflem, for your hospitality and support throughout our stay.

We stayed 5 nights and had a lovely time. It was a perfect, comfortable space for my family of 4, and it was very convenient for walking, shopping, and accessing transit. The kitchen was well-equipped to cook in, the beds were comfortable, Gulfem was very responsive and helpful with offering recommendations - she even helped us find a hospital when my daughter needed medical treatment.
It’s mentioned in the listing, but take note that the apartment is on the 4th floor of a building without a lift.

Our first visit to Instanbul and our stay here was perfect for us as a family of three. Apartment was very clean and had amazing views of the city. Bedrooms were really comfy and the bathroom has a great power shower and was very clean.
Our hostess was very helpful in providing a guide to the local transport and amenities. The check in instructions were very clear and easy to follow.
Many thanks for a lovely stay

My family and I had an amazing stay at Gulfem's place! The apartment had modern appliances (so thankful for the dishwasher and dryer!) and the AC was sufficient for Istanbul's summers. The apartment was fitted with every thing we could need.
The neighbourhood was close to Galata and all attractions were accessible by walking and/or public transport. The surrounding area had a lot of character (albeit a little dirty) but I admired the artistic vibe and we always felt safe.
Gülfem was kind and communicative, she gave us amazing recommendations for the city. Would highly recommend!

description: Find solace in this modern 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment located on the first floor. The beautiful white building welcomes you to a newly furnished space with high ceilings and abundant natural light. Relax in the comfortable living area, make use of the fully equipped kitchen, and enjoy the convenience of a sofa bed for extra guests. Step out onto the balcony to soak in the sun. Stay entertained with the smart TV featuring Netflix and Amazon Prime. Experience tranquility and comfort in Solace.

reviews.text: Great location. Airbnb was pretty much the same size as in the photos. The balconies though were very very tiny. Everything was great except for a few things like there being no toilet paper once we arrived. Luckily there was mini mart walking distance. Our first few days consisted of being woken up at 9AM due to sounds of construction right outside our window. Quite inconvenient and very disturbing. The construction eventually stopped a few days into our stay. There is also only one AC so had to keep it on otherwise it would get too hot especially at night. Overall stay was great with regards to cleanliness and location. Building was also easy to get in and out of. Would recommend. (If you don't speak English pls note it will be practically impossible to use the washing machine).

Aynı fotoğraflarda olduğu gibi temiz bir evdi. Konum itibariyle de oldukça rahattı. Muhit nezih ve self check-in büyük bir rahatlık. Ev sahibi gerekli tüm bilgileri sağlıyor. Ev ile alakalı tek olumsuz durum daireler arasında ses yalıtımı iyi değil. Yan ve üst dairelerdeki tüm konuşmalar evin içindeymiş gibi duyuluyor. Onun haricinde her şey çok güzeldi. Ses yalıtımı sağlanırsa kesinlikle tekrar kalmayı tercih ederim.

It is a beautiful lovely house. The location is very good, metro line is within 15 min walk. A bunch of lovely cats are guarding the house. The house is suitable for 2 people, and well furnished and spotless clean.
Only one thing of the lights, the sunshine is limited on the first floor. And the light is not very bright.
However Kever the house owner is very responsive and helpful, the gas has some problem at the first night 10pm. Kever helped us all the time and responded very fast and solved the problem.

Kevser was excellent, we didn't have much communication at the beginning but during the stay she was very understanding and careful when I added more days. The apartment is a 15-minute walk from Marmaray and Metrobus stations, making it easier to get around Istanbul. The condominium is new and they were still making some adjustments, so I had some problems with noise but nothing that bothered me. Spacious and comfortable apartment. I will come back again!
One of the most comfortable places in Istanbul. Secure, clean and pristine. Host was insanely helpful even send back the earphones that I forgot in the building.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: This place was definitely worth it for the price. The location was really good in the center of Galata. It is on quite a noisy side alley woth bars and clubs and there is loud music playing outside the window late, however the Hotel provided earplugs free of charge so the music didn’t keep us up. Maybe not the place for light sleepers though. Also the shower was a bit mouldy / dirty. The bed was very comfy! Overall definitely worth it for the price!

The hotel is a lovely period building in the heart of the city. It’s particularly well located for high street shopping and bars.
The room was well equipped, clean and pleasant. The decor was starting to get a bit faded and it will need refurbishment in a couple of years time.
Staff were very nice and couldn’t have been more helpful or friendly.
Very good value for money and recommended.

Despite the description says it’s noisy is way more than just “noisy” you can hardly sleep. One thing is open air music and noise, I can tolerate that but hearing music and people inside the room as I’m part of the party is not just “noise” is way beyond any tolerable measure, especially for a hotel where you come to rest. On other topic there’s the bathroom smell , sewer smell during the whole stay coming from the sink, their solution was just putting some air freshener that didn’t do anything. Air conditioning also doesn’t work, it just makes noise, I pointed this out a couple of times but wasn’t taking into consideration. Bed sheets and towels smell like food, like some kind of fried oil smell, the same smell that is in the whole building.
The cherry on top was the last day having a water coming from the sink, the installation of the ducts is so poor that it just came out from the wall.
Avoid this place at all costs, they didn’t gave me any solution to improve my stay

Affordable and good access to istiklal caddesi. Yes there’s noise but didn’t bother us as much.
There was a smell in the room. Aircon didn’t work well. Hair in the shower. It’s why I expected for the price we paid.

Highly recommended. The check-in staff were kind, helpful, and readily available for assistance. The location was ideal, and the cleanliness of the hotel was top-notch, making for a very pleasant stay.

description: This room is a beautifully designed Studio which offers everything you need for a short term stay. The studio offers a private bathroom with shower, a well equipped small kitchenette, a large size tv, free wifi, A.C. and central heating. Free room service once every 2 day and 24 hours doorman makes your stay more comfortable. You can also enjoy your coffee at the 18 hours available information desk while you are getting information about secrets of city or answers of your questions.

reviews.text:
I’m so happy I found these apartments. The location is incredibly convenient - just a 5-mins walk from the heart of Istanbul and the Blue Mosque, yet the area is surprisingly quiet.
My goal was to rest and recover after a long flight and this place was perfect for that. At the same time, I could easily explore the city since everything was within walking distance.
The hosts were extremely kind and responsive. They were always quick to help whenever I needed anything, and they even helped me with my laundry, which I really appreciated.
I would also like to mention there was absolutely no unpleasant smell in the room. It seems that the issue mentioned in some older reviews has been completely resolved. The room smelled fresh, was very clean, and felt comfortable. As a nice bonus, there was a really good hair dryer, which made me happy.
Here, everything you need is provided. The value for money is simply excellent. I highly recommend this place and will definitely stay here next time.

Room was very clean and had everything we needed. Kitchen was also very useful with the necessary utensils. Room was soundproof if you kept the windows closed and the neighborhood was quiet at night, so it's was easy to sleep. Access to a lot of transportation so exploring the city was easy. Supermarket also very close. The host was kind and helpful. I recommend the place 100% and was worth the money. If I ever go back to İstanbul I would probably choose it again ☺️

Very convenient location with friendly and helpful host. The lack of cleanliness and uncomfortable bathroom made the stay much less pleasant than it could have been. There was a constant smell of sewage coming from the bathroom during the whole stay. The host kindly attempted to mediate the situation but unfortunately it was only a temporary fix. The bathroom is small and uncomfortable to use, but that is a limitation of the space available. The best thing about the room is the lighting and wooden planks behind the bed. If only the room were better maintained with more focus on comfort and cleanliness, it could have been a great stay.

I booked on a very short notice and needed to check in really early in the morning, as I’ve just arrived to Istanbul after a 12 hour trip – Erol and Bilal were extremely flexible and helpful! They replied almost immediately and helped me to check in early, which literally saved my day, I’m truly grateful for that. 🙏
The place is a few minutes away from Sultanahmet Mosque, right in the heart of Istanbul. 🕌
Even though it is in such a central location, it’s cozy and peaceful, and looks just like the photos! I can wholeheartedly recommend staying in this cozy downtown hideaway. 🤗

This was a great place for a short-term stay, and I definitely recommend it. It was very clean, easy to access, and had everything needed for a few days. The only downside was that it was a bit small, but considering the price, location, and overall comfort, it was a great experience for me.

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service, assistance for your concierge needs and dedicated parking space, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text: Gülşah was the best host ever and the place was awesome. She was extremely accommodating and allowed me to check in very early. She even provided me with her personal salon blow dryer and straightener because mine weren’t dual voltage, and an adaptor because I’d forgotten mine. She made great recommendations for food and activities. The apartment was beautiful and sparkling clean. The daily cleaning service was a great touch (you can opt out if you prefer), as was the little selection of drinks in three refrigerator that were restocked daily. I loved the huge comfy bed, and the super fast minisplit which cooled the place down in less than ten minutes. It was also (no exaggeration) the best shower I’ve ever had in my life. The location is convenient and right next to the tram, and Beyoğlu is beautiful. I’ll stay here again when I return to Istanbul, for sure. It was an A+.

Mehmet was very kind and proactive host. Since the place quite new, he was always in touch for meeting out needs and communicated for improving small details.
The location was superb, easy to walk or take the tram to many locations we planned to go. The street itself is very nice and live. We adored the furnitures of the appartment. The bed was super comfy. Cleaning ladies were mostly around to help and clean. Strongly recommended!

We enjoyed our stay. The room had enough storage and made us feel comfortable. Gulsha was responsive and helpful. Always provided with extra toiletries. Room is as it was in pictures, near all the great locations.

This place is cool and modern in a great area close to Galataport Promenade. The place was very clean and the bed was comfortable. The apartment was writhing walking distance of the Istanbul Museum and tons of shops and restaurants. I was comfortable and happy to stay here and definitely recommend it.

This is our favorite area to stay in Istanbul, and we were thrilled to find such an amazing place here! Everything exceeded our expectations, from the seamless check-in process to the smooth check-out. The apartment was spotless, beautifully decorated, and equipped with everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location is unbeatable – close to local attractions, shops, and great restaurants, yet still peaceful and quiet at night. The host was incredibly kind, responsive, and attentive to every detail, making us feel truly welcome. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience and can’t wait to return. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: Tamamen fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Ev temizdi mobilyalar temizdi kötü koku yoktu. Böcek vs yoktu. Ev sahibi soru sormaya gerek kalmadan detaylı ve anlaşılır bilgi verdi. Tekrar tercih edebileceğim bir konaklama deneyimi oldu bizim için. Konumu güzel genel olarak ulaşımı rahat bir konumdaydı. Teşekkür ederiz

This rental was absolutely stunning! It was modern, spacious, and super functional. The apartment had everything you could ever need, including a fully equipped kitchen and all the amenities you could imagine. The only minor downside was that the place was a bit dusty from the bedsheets but the bed was incredibly comfortable! The room might be a bit dark for some people, but I personally love it and find it bright enough. The WiFi was a bit slow, and the air conditioning had some issues, but the host was super helpful and explained how it worked, so it turned out okay. Overall, I highly recommend staying at this beautiful rental!

Overall, a very good experience. The flat was comfortable, great value for the price, and communication with the agent was excellent. I really appreciated being able to leave my luggage in the flat. The only minor issue was that the curtains were quite transparent, but aside from that, everything was great Very near walk to the tram.

The Airbnb was so clean and comfortable, There were some tiny hiccups but Gulsah was able to resolve them quickly. The Airbnb is in such a great location to find many restaurants and museums. The train was near by and able to travel multiple places with ease. Gulsah was able to recommend multiple restaurants, nightlife and tourist locations.

Gülşah very nice to other people 😊 And she is very helpful to solve your problems.
Apartment is pretty and comfortable.
Unfortunately the air-conditioner did not work on the first night, but luckily it recover at the next day.
Before 1 am, you will hear the sound from night club. As I have the earplugs, so it is acceptable.
Location really close to T1 & bus station👍🏻

description:
This special place is close to everything and makes it easy to plan your trip.

In Cihangir, the heart of Taksim, we provide 1 bedroom and a sofa that can be turned into a double bed, and up to 2 extra folding beds if desired, so 5 people can easily stay in our apartment. You will feel at peace in this private apartment equipped with trees and modern breezes. We offer you a living space that is free from the noise of the city despite being in the center

reviews.text:
The place was great, and the apartment was very nice. It was a little smaller than expected, but it was good since the location is very central in Taksim. They were very responsive, and there was no problem getting in.
The only two issues were: one of the rooms doesn't have AC, so it could get very hot in there, and the owner forgot to clean the dishwasher entirely, so it had a smell.
Apart from that, I would recommend it 100%.

Kaan Bey’in evinde çok keyifli bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Ev Beyoğlu’nun merkezinde, ulaşım ve çevredeki mekanlara yakın. Temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğünden daha ferah. Kaan Bey ve ekip arkadaşı Dilan hanım son derece ilgili, iletişimi hızlı ve misafirperverler. Kendimi evimde gibi hissettim. İstanbul’da konaklamak isteyen herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

The apartment was great. Located in a very calm and safe street. literally 3 to 5 minutes walking distance to Taksim square. Far from the noisy streets of Istiklal.
I highly recommend booking this place. It was clean, same as the pictures only ot looked bigger in the pictures. it was enough for 3 people.
Dilan was very helpful, supportive and very responsive.
5 🌟.

Ev sahibimiz her anlamda harikaydı! Evin temizliği, konforu ve küçük detaylara gösterilen özen sayesinde kendimi adeta kendi evimde gibi hissettim. İletişimi çok hızlı ve nazikti, her soruma yanıt verdi. Konum harikaydı, çevrede ihtiyacım olan her şey vardı. Bu deneyim beklentilerimin çok ötesindeydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederim, tekrar gelirsem başka bir yer aramama gerek yok 🌟

This experience was completely unacceptable and misleading. The property’s location was far from what was presented in the listing. Even after reservation, the same misleading location was shown until arrival, when we discovered we had to walk few more minutes down a very steep downhill road with our luggage, which was unsafe while traveling with a child.
The apartment itself was uninhabitable: it was very old, the refrigerator was frozen, the stove was broken, and a stray street cat was living inside. We could not stay there for more than a minute.
I immediately contacted Dilan (Kaan’s partner). The only response was: “This is an Airbnb rule; we cannot state the exact location before reservation. If you want, I can refund your money.” No attempt was made to help us find alternative accommodation, despite it being midnight and us traveling as a family.
As a result, we spent over two hours searching for hotels and had to make an expensive last-minute booking, costing $500.

description: Our facility is located in the oldest part of Istanbul. What we love about being in our neighborhood is that you are located between 6 amazing 'must see' areas in the heart of Istanbul - Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet Mosque, Topkapi Palace, Istanbul Archaeological Museum complex. Many of Istanbul's most popular attractions are within a 10-minute walk - our location is super central and there is no need to take the metro or bus after checking in.

reviews.text: Our stay was bitter sweet, Adil was nice and responsive even with the language barrier, we were able to communicate. But when we arrived, he told us the room we had booked actually has a “malfunction” so we ended up in a smaller and different room. The hotel is well located to famous spots in Istanbul, walking distance; and lots of good places to eat. There was a random electricity outage at some point, it lasted about 5 -6 hours, it’s not his fault but was inconvenient for sure!

I had a great stay at Adil’s place! The apartment was clean, spacious, and exactly as shown in the pictures. The location in the old city was perfect for exploring nearby attractions. Check-in was smooth, and Adil was responsive and helpful. Would definitely recommend.

Host was friendly and there to welcome us. The place is as shown in pictures and walking distance to many of the famous attractions. Accessible via taxi and Uber. Easy checkout process also. Will stay again if in town.

We had a pleasant stay at Adil's apartment. The place was clean and had all the listed amenities. It was practically at the centre of Istanbul, within walking distance of all the tourist attractions one might want to visit. There were also lots of shops and restaurants nearby, where you can grab food or buy anything you need. Considering that the hotel is in a busy area, the noise coming from the street was minimal and we were able to sleep comfortably throughout our stay. I definitely recommend Adil's place to other guests!

We had a wonderful stay! This was our second visit to Istanbul, and once again everything was perfect. The hosts are truly great—always helpful, responsive, and kind.
The place itself is excellent: very well-equipped, comfortable, and in a fantastic location close to everything you need. Nothing was missing, and we felt right at home throughout our stay.
We really enjoyed our time here and would definitely love to come back again!

description:
The stone building was built in 2020 and decorated in accordance with the environment.
The flat decorated by an architect and all brand new. The apartment has 49m2 covered Garden.
Each bedroom comes with A&C.
Süleymaniye Mosque - 2min
Nearest metro station ( Vezneciler ) - 6min
Grand Bazaar - 10min
EminÖnü - 10 min

There is a open car paid-parking area ( İspark ) just beside the building.
You can easily find cafes and restaurants around the building.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Sena and Serhad’s place in Istanbul. The apartment was exactly as described—clean, spacious, beautifully decorated, and very comfortable for our family. One of the best things about it is the location—right behind the magnificent Süleymaniye Mosque in a quiet and historic neighbourhood. It’s well-connected by public transport and also within walking distance (about 20–30 minutes) to major sights like the Sultan Ahmed Mosque and Hagia Sophia.
Sena and Serhad were exceptional hosts—warm, responsive, and genuinely caring. They made sure everything was ready for us, and their attention to detail made our stay extra special. It really felt like a home away from home.
Highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul, especially families looking for a peaceful, well-equipped space with a local feel and wonderful hosts. We’d love to return!

Loved our stay at Sena’s apartment. It was very large, modern and beautifully renovated. They clearly pay attention to the little details that make a stay more comfortable from the well equipped kitchen, good quality comfortable furnishings and even a decent hair dryer and washing machine. We enjoyed sitting in the outdoor courtyard and would definitely come again if returning to istanbul. Very walkable to restaurants and attractions nearby.
One thing to note is that the apartment is down a flight of stairs so it is not accessible friendly.

Our stay at this Airbnb was absolutely perfect - exactly as described in the listing and photos. The four of us had an amazing time! The location is fantastic, with everything within easy walking distance, including the Grand Bazaar, which was just a 10-15 minute walk away. After long days exploring the streets of Istanbul, it was a wonderful place to relax and unwind. Serhad was an exceptional host - truly one of the sweetest and most responsive I’ve ever encountered. He went above and beyond to assist us with every question and need. If I could give him 10 stars, I would. Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

The place was very clean and comfortable, it had everything we needed. The bed rooms were big and there was a nice living room. The hosts are so friendly and helpful as they provided us with transportation from and to the airport and also were checking if we needed something daily. it's located in a really great spot near wonderful historical sights like the suleymaniye mosque and the grand bazaar is also easy to get to. In addition, a lot of bakeries, tea houses and restaurant were around.
Overall, we had a really great experience and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and is looking for a "local" type of experience.
Everything about this apartment was amazing. The location was really comfortable, it was very clean, the host was very kind and help us with whatever we needed. For sure I will recommend this place.

description: Don't miss the chance to stay in a completely safe and exclusive tourist area reserved for hotels. If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment! The location is absolutely perfect—right in Taksim Square, close to everything. The apartment was clean, spacious, and exactly as described, with three comfortable bedrooms that easily accommodated our group.
Cem was an amazing host—very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. He kindly allowed us early check-in and late check-out, which made our travel plans so much easier. Highly recommended, and we’d definitely stay here again!

I had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The place is spacious, very clean, and well-heated, which made it especially comfortable. The check-in and check-out process was simple and smooth with clear instructions. The owner is extremely friendly, helpful, and always quick to respond, which made the whole experience even better. I would definitely recommend this apartment and would be happy to stay here again.

perfect location, great size rooms,private, safe area, bad thing is nobody check flat to make sure everything is working or if it's not, try to fix it ASAP before guest check in,just the problem I had about 1 of shower bathroom door was missed( 1 bath can not use), the rest of the area was acceptable ( not perfect with the money I paid).

Thank you for accomodating us. easy check in and check out. Cem was very responsive, if there was any issues or anything needed he was very quick to response and brought us what was needed.
Amazing location
overall had a great experience.
thank you again 🙏

Good location - good size of rooms, living and bathrooms
But it needs little maintenance and renovation specifically for bathrooms - Ac and ventilation

description:
Located in Cihangir, one of Istanbul's most popular districts, the apartment offers a perfect stay for families and groups of friends with 3 separate beds. Just a few minutes' walk from Taksim Square, Istiklal Avenue and public transport stops.
Cihangir's famous cafes, restaurants and art-filled streets are right at your doorstep. An ideal choice for those seeking a central location.

reviews.text:
We stayed in Istanbul for 5 nights and wanted to be as central as possible. The appartement is close to the bus lines and a short walk from a metro and tram station. The only downside would be that it is facing the hospital entry, so it might be noisy at night.
Our host Bibek was very responsive and helpful during our time there.
As for the appartement, it mostly corresponds to the description and pictures, but some of the furniture and the kitchen utensils at far beyond their life expectancy and should be replaced, and an oven instead of a dishwasher would be welcome for people that do not want to eat out multiple times a day.
The bathroom and bedroom doors are also broken and cannot be closed properly, as well as the shower door.
Overall, the appartement is still a very good value if your main goal is to explore the city all day long and only sleep there.

We stayed in this place for 5 days as a group of three girls. We really felt safe, as there are always people around in the neighborhood. It also had great location. Checkin and checkout were easy and flexible. Host was kind. The place was accurately described on the airbnb. It was generally clean. Great stay for this cheap of a price tbh. Definetely would recommend :)

Pretty good location, everything is very close by and disco areas are a bit aside.
Apartment itself is exactly as it shown at the photos.
Clean. That's important.
The only thing is very thin walls, but it's not host's fault of course 😀.
So with reasonable price that apartment from Özgür is definitely recommended.

Place is about 5 minutes from taksim. Great location. Place was clean with no mess. Overall great value for money. Place is located near hospital and it can be noisy deep in the night with a lot of cars passing by with loud music. Beds could be replaced and mattress. Great communication with Bibek. Thank you
Evin konumu gayet güzel. Rahatça yürünüyor her tarafa. Host ise gayet yardımcı ve iyiydi. Ev temiz aynı fotolardaki gibi.

description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

reviews.text:
The apartment itself was excellent—very clean, spacious, and perfect for a family. The only improvement I'd suggest is adding an AC unit to the back bedroom.
Unfortunately, my experience with the host was very disappointing. I accidentally booked for 1 guest instead of 4, even though I had booked the same apartment for 4 people the previous night. The difference was only about $2 ($66 vs. $68), and I immediately offered to pay it. Instead, the host demanded an extra $32 per additional guest, effectively trying to charge me twice for the stay. Since my booking was non-refundable, I had no real choice. After hours of discussions with the host and Airbnb, the reservation was canceled, and I had to book directly with them. The whole situation ruined my day. I found the host's behavior unprofessional, dishonest, and exploitative.

Genel itibari ile fiyat performanstı sadece banyoda bir önceki konaklayanlardan kalan tıraş bıçağı bırakılmıştı ondan kaynaklı temizlikten emin olamadık odaya girdiğimizde soğuktu ve klimaların kumandası yoktu resepsiyon odada olduğunu söylediği için bi süre aradık sonrasında tekrar inip sorduğumuzda yerden ısıtma sistemi olduğu söylendi ve ayarlandı bilgi aktarımda ufak bi problem yaşadık karşısında belediye tesisi dışında çay kahve içilebilecek alanlar sınırlı aktif bir yer olduğunu düşünüyorum ve cadde üzeri olduğu için park sorunu çok fazla

Konum olarak metroya 6-7 dk yürüme mesafesi, temizlik 10 numaraydı. Fakat giriş saati bence hatalı yazılmış çünkü çıkış saati de 12, eğer odanızda sizden önce birisi varsa haliyle temizlik için sizden 1-2 saat arası süre isteniyor. Biz 55 dakikada girebildik, fakat zamanında girebilsek haliyle daha mutlu olurduk. Onun dışında seyahatimizi sevdik.

Biz 2 yetişkin 1 çocuk ve 1 bebek olmak üzere 4 kişi konakladık. Dairenin genişliği ve temizliği çok iyi salon ve yatak odasında klimanın olması güzel eşyalar yeni ve temizdi beyaz eşyalara kadar ince düşünülmüş İstanbul/Avrupa yakasında işi olanlar için kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

İlk defa bu uygulamayı kullanarak bir yerde kalmayı deneyimledik ve fazlasıyla memnun kaldık. Tuttuğumuz daire cok temizdi ve tam istediğimiz gibi ihtiyaçlarımızı karşıladı. Hem gezdik hem de market alısverisi yaparak mutfağı dilediğimiz gibi kullandık kendi yemeğimizi kendimiz yaptık ve sunduğunuz imkanlar bizim için önemliydi çok teşekkür ederiz. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz. Biz genel olarak gideceğimiz yerlere yürüyerek gittik konum olarak da yeri güzel. Bir dahaki gelişimizde daha uzun kalmayı planlıyoruz. Emeğinize sağlık

description: Welcome to our comfortable apartment, perfectly located between Taksim and Nişantaşı! Just a 10-15 minute walk to Taksim Square or the chic Nişantaşı district, you'll enjoy the best of both worlds. We provide monthly cleaning on long stays, fresh linens, and building maintenance, with all utilities included (electricity, heating, water, and internet). Markets, restaurants, theaters, shopping malls, and more are just steps away. Experience the vibrant city life and a cozy stay with us!

reviews.text:
a great deal for the price. Clean, quiet, with a central location in Taksim. Bed is comfortable, couch is comfortable. washing machine and kitchen appliances available and convenient.
just outside there is a small shop that sells mostly everything you need. open till 2:30 am. you can pay with card as well.
overall amazing place to stay at

It was really a nice stay. The location is great. It is very close to both metro stations: Taksim Square and Osmanbey. During my stay, Taksim Square metro station was closed several times for some reasons, but it didn't really bother me, because I could still use Osmanbey station. There are a lot of extremely steep slopes in that area, which is quite annoying, but thankfully the way from the apartment to the main road is not that steep and acceptable to me. The apartment itself was also nice. It was clean and tidy and had everything I needed. Some kitchenware was of good quality, which I liked. The hosts are nice, polite, and good at English. They responded immediately when I told something and they could fix the problem very soon.

comfortable apartment in a good location. Host was friendly and responsive to communication.
Excellent WiFi as well, good for working

We had a great stay! The apartment was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed. Check-in was easy, and the host was responsive and helpful throughout. The location was quiet yet close to shops, restaurants, and public transport. It truly felt like a home away from home. Highly recommended!
Ahmet is a great guy. The apartment is simply EXCELLENT, much better than the pictures show. The location is convenient and quiet. I will definitely repeat in that place.

description: artDeco is a newly renovated and refurbished suite with balcony with full amenities as 24/7 hot water, LCD HD TV with satellite, super fast wifi, in the best possible location in Istanbul, making it a perfect short-term stay for either couples or individuals.

reviews.text:
I stayed at the apartment for one month
I found it to be clean Quiet fresh and comfortable.
A comfortable bed . .Hot water Powerful aircon and enough amenities Kettle fridge and TV and large shower room and W.C and terrace. There is a washing machine and Tumble dryer ( free to use) and cleaning utensils for your apartment on the ground floor .The apartment is really so close to local stores . transport and Tourist attractions .. And for the low cost of rental . I feel is a absolute bargain ..
.Ogul the landlord
I found to be articulate. Well mannered and has a caring disposition regarding his guests and requests ...His welcome page on Air B@B is really one of the best..So informative and detailed for new guests ( I have been to istanbul many times over 10 years and never have I seen such a informative welcome page )
I felt safe secure and comfortable with ogul and his fast communication with myself before and during my stay .
I would recommend ogul residences

Ogul is a very nice, funny and respectable host, he never hesitated to help with whatever he could to ensure I had no problems during my stay. He reaches out even if I don't.
The place is just as described, super clean and comfy located in the most strategic place in my opinion, in closest calm street to Istiklal. There is not much sound isolation so you shouldn't be noisyl
Bus is 2 minutes away.
Metro is 5-10 minutes away.
Istiklal street 5 minutes away.

The best host I've ever had. Ogul is a superb host, and I think even that is an understatement. My girlfriend and I spent just short of a month in here, and we enjoyed every bit time we spent here. The location of the place couldn't be better, it's just a very short walk to Taksim square, and the metro. I highly recommend booking this room. It's very clean and comfortable, and not to mention ran by a great host. Ogul gave us a very helpful instruction for the location of the building, and he also provided us recommendation for awesome restaurants and places to see. We couldn't be more satisfied with our stay. Thank you Ogul!

it was advertised as an apartment but it was just a room with a bathroom. The pictures were also misleading as it showed the room as much lagrer than it was in reality. We barely had any space to walk around.
There was no cleaning service ecen though we were promised that, they never changed sheets or towels. The washing machine and dryer was broken and the door and lock was hard to open. We could only open the door halfway.
The walls were very thin and you could hear everyone and everyone can hear you. There was several floors which never came up in the description and there was also no elevator so be prepared to carry your heavy bags up several stairs.
The only good thing about it was the location because it was very central and close to resturants and shopping.

Fairly small 3rd floor apartment with no lift and the check-in procedure was a bit odd but the host was very helpful and attentive and the flat was in a convenient location. Water cut out on the final day but apparently this wasn't the only flat affected.

description: This stylish place is close to must-see places. Our facility, which is within walking distance to Hagia Sophia, Sultanahmet Mosque, Basilica Cistern and many historical buildings, is ready to provide you, our valued guests, with the best and most comfortable accommodation experience. Our extremely comfortable rooms have a kitchen and all the ingredients for you to cook. Our air-conditioned rooms with hot water are ready to host you. We have a 24-hour reception service.

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay. The host is one of the kindest people I’ve met and always went out of his way to help whenever he could. If you need anything, just ask, if it’s possible, he will do his best to make it happen.
The room was perfect and had everything I needed. It’s located in Istanbul’s shoe manufacturing district, which was a unique experience. I enjoyed seeing local craftsmen making shoes, and you can even buy directly from them at better prices than elsewhere.
The area is very quiet at night, yet the tram is only a 7-minute walk away, making it easy to explore the city.
The shower had excellent water pressure and plenty of hot water, exactly how I like it. The air conditioning was also amazing. Coming from Thailand, good air-con is a must!
The host always replied quickly and was incredibly helpful. He can arrange a private airport transfer for around €55, which is convenient and helps avoid potential taxi scams.
I would happily stay here again and highly recommend! ⭐️⭐️⭐

stayed only one night out of the 3 booked due to water outage which was not the fault of the property (municipal-wide), but the time water was supposed to be back on kept getting delayed (just yo note that this can happen!)
Omer was kind enough to agree to refund the other nights as we found a hotel that has it's own water depot.
room on 3rd floor was not fantastic, can hear street noise and also internal noise when other guests are using the stairs or talking excitedly.
attention: narrow staircases and halls that makes it impossible for persons with reduced mobility, and hilly area outside. also, taxis may not be able to enter at specific times of day (automatic barriers down the road).
Omer and his brother are kind and good people. the accommodation is of.very good value.
to those who like to walk, it is close to areas of interest. the Neighborhood is less colourful than one might want to have when holidaying.
kitchen area just has one pan and 2 sets of plates

Pros:
In historical centrum. Apartment is close to famous sightseeings.
Groceries and restaurants are close.
The location is safe.
Ömer is very responsive.
Cons:
No shower doors.
AC is noisy a bit and not effective unless it’s on all the time.
Steep stairs without elevator
Overall it was pleasant stay. Ömer owns Leyan Suits. There are 3 floor of the same kind so your room can positionally differ from the picture a bit.

We had an amazing stay and truly enjoyed every moment. Omer is a fantastic host – friendly, welcoming, and always helpful. He made us feel at home from the very beginning.
The hotel itself is excellent, with a beautiful and stylish design that creates a great atmosphere. Everything is clean, well-maintained, and very comfortable. The location is also perfect, with shops, restaurants, and attractions all within walking distance.
We would highly recommend staying here to anyone visiting the area. Thank you, Omer, for such a wonderful experience – we would love to come back again!☺️

The accommodation is exactly as described. Very new and modern furnishings. The apartments are located in the district right next to the main sights, which are very easy to reach on foot. Check-in went smoothly and any queries were dealt with quickly and in a very friendly manner. Unfortunately, the district in which the apartment is located is a bit run-down (but the accommodation is definitely not). However, this doesn't matter as Istanbul generally offers various districts. I would visit the guys again! :)

description: Welcome to our lovely safe haven duplex home tucked away in our peaceful green patio. Moments from the beautiful Bosphorus where you can enjoy a nice walk along the coast. Comes with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with an additional powder room with a walk in closet, a beautiful modern open fully equipped kitchen and a spacious living room, air conditioning, wifi & Netflix!. Enjoy outdoor space in the summer sun. The perfect place to call home!

reviews.text:
This is a great location for a private stay in Istanbul. 3 minutes down the stairs, and you are at the Bosporus for the greatest walks ever.
Just make sure to plan your arrival with the taxi, because the house is on a steep hill.
House was equipped with every thing one can think of: necessary furniture, cooking , cleaning, etc.
Wonderful hosts who are very helpful and responsive. Plus, they are trustworthy. After we checked out from the apartment, they reached out to us regarding an item that we had forgotten behind.
Any time I come back to Istanbul, we will seek to stay at a VNG property

The neighborhood is a unique place that any tourist should consider when visiting Istanbul. While options on Airbnb are limited in this area, it won’t be easy to find a house with two bathrooms like this one. The house was so nice and I liked how you can easily go to the Bosporus and get your coffee from espresso lab. VNG team are very responsive and friendly. I would recommend their listings based on their level of support and service. The only thing to consider in this property is hot water availability. Since there is a central tank feeding the building , you’re subjected to not to find hot water all the time. I think in summer this won’t be an issue for any guest but in winter , you’d need to consider this concern

We had a lovely stay here! The location is greay and just a 2-minute walk to the Bosphorus, which made it very easy to enjoy beautiful walks by the water. The host was very responsive and helpful, and even arranged to store our luggage, which we really appreciated.
Do keep in mind that the flat is on a steep hill, so it may not be ideal for families with young children or anyone with mobility issues. The building itself is older and the flat bathrooms would benefit from a bit of refreshing, however nothing major for a short stay.
Overall, a great spot if you’re looking for a convenient base near the Bosphorus with a thoughtful host.

The main issue was the presence of dead scorpion, spiders, and ants, both at the entrance and inside the house. There were also cobwebs at the entrance. When I asked them to clean the house, they said they didn’t have time despite telling them that my 2 and half years old daughter is with us , but offered a two-hour late checkout instead which I didn’t need as I was leaving early. Furthermore, when I messaged them about the cleaning issues, their responses were irrelevant, focusing on how to check out. Considering they charge a cleaning fee equivalent to a night’s stay, the cleaning service should match the price paid. The positive thing was the heating.

Dairenin konumu ve içi güzel, muhitte huzur var ancak ana yatak odası banyosunda nem/küf/ rutubet sorunu söz konusuydu. Bu durum yatak odasındaki yatağı ferahlıkla kullanmayı zorlaştırıyor. Onun dışında başka ufak tefek aksaklıklar da yaşadık, sıcak su sorunu için yardımcı olmaya çalıştılar, 2-3 günde halloldu. Internet de zaman zaman kopuyor ve bağlantının düzensiz olduğu mesajı alınabiliyor. Yine de hoş bir deneyim.

description:
Let this sparkling and spacious apartment take you on an adventure!

Our place will give you a taste of the timeless existence of this bustling city!

The shared terrace of the building is overlooking the Bosphorus and the Golden Horn. The panoramic view extends from the first bridge to the Asian side all the way to Hagia Sophia & Topkapı Palace. You can enjoy the terrace day and night!

The apt. has all the amenities you may need, it is 1 minute walk away from the famous Galata Tower.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Daria's place for 3 nights to celebrate my birthday.
We loved the flat, plain and nicely decorated, very clean, confortable beds. kitchen has everything we needed. Lovely shower.
It was very quiet, (maybe because it's winter), I loved that.
Galata tower is right there, very close to the flat.
We walked everywhere. There are many restaurants, cafés and stores nearby. We walked to Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque and Bosphorus boat trip and everywhere.
The terrace has an amazing view. Unfortunately it rained all day every day and we could not enjoy it. It is a wonderful spot to have a glass of wine on a warm night, maybe next time.
If I ever return to Istanbul, I would look for the same flat.
The only thing that I would like to point out is the stairs to the 3rd floor. It is a bit steep, but nothing to put you off.
Glad we chose Daria's place. Thank you.

The place was totally as it was described, clean cosy and centrally located. The host was very responsive and accommodating, easy and pleasant to deal with. The only challenging moment was the crowded and noisy location, it should be taken into consideration while planning the trip. Everything is very close, but also the level of the city noise at night is quite overwhelming.

The location is amazing and the terrace offers a beautiful view. The house was clean and as described and the hosts are responsive. It does get a little noisy on the streets and you can hear it from the house, not the biggest problem though.

What a perfect place! We really appreciated the quick communication from Daria & Oktay. Their place is super cute, has everything you need, and makes you feel right at home. The beds and pillows were very comfortable. The location is top notch and walking distance to all the best food, shopping, and sight seeing. We really loved the rooftop terrace, the view was incredible. Its a shared space but we always had it to ourselves. If you have children or a lot of bags, make sure to check in ahead of time to arrange help since there is no elevator. We were greeted and helped with our bags upon arrival. Istanbul is our favorite city and we found a new favorite spot to stay. Thanks!!

This apartment is in a very exciting part of the city just steps from Galata Tower. We loved the central location and were able to walk to most tourist destinations and restaurants. The apartment is very clean with comfortable beds. Views from shared rooftop deck are remarkable. It’s worth noting that this place requires lots of stair climbing.

description: Luxury apartment on the main street, 50 meters from the metro

reviews.text:
Before I say anything about the property, let me say that the Host and their team were extremely helpful, very responsive and friendly. We faced a few issues during our stay and the Host was extremely helpful and dealt with all the issues in a very short time. They were very friendly and response time was very fast. Mr Ata was extremely helpful and kind.
The property is in an excellent location. Near Metro for those who use public transport. Walk able distance to many locations such as Taksim Sq and Isteghlal Street. Many shops, and restaurants and take away and super markets around. The street is busy and feels safe.
The property is large enough for three families and has enough beds to accommodate 9 people. The beds were nice and comfortable. The bathroom needs some touch ups. The shower is of a small size. Overall we had a good stay.

Absolutely fantastic experience with Murat as our Airbnb host in Istanbul! After another host canceled our booking less than 24 hours before check-in, we were in a real bind! Murat came through for us in the most incredible way, accommodating our group at the very last minute.
His communication was top-notch from the get-go, always prompt and clear, which made the entire process smooth and stress-free. The apartment itself was immaculate – shiny, clean, and exactly as described. It was evident that Murat takes great pride in maintaining a high standard for his guests.
Any issues or concerns we had were addressed immediately, showcasing his dedication to ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Murat's hospitality truly made our trip memorable. We couldn't have asked for a better host and would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a place to stay in Istanbul.
Thank you, Murat, for your exceptional service and for turning a stressful situation into a wonderful experience!
Great location and a friendly, supportive host. However, the kitchen needs more equipment and better cleaning and hygiene standards.

Great Apartment for a big family to stay in suburban Istanbul. Roomy, with four bedrooms, we very much enjoyed our stay here. Place is Very accessible, lots of restaurants and shopping centers around this location. Walking distances from Bosporus. Across the street from subway station. Plus you can hitch a ride in a taxi in an instant. First story of the building where the apartment is, there is a restaurant with big variations of home-style food, very delicious.
We will definitely consider booking again
We had a lovely stay. The hists where kind and responsive. The house was clean and as dsscribed. But the bathroom could be updated.

description: From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. Our place, designed for large groups to spend their vacation both economically and comfortably, is ready to offer you everything you need.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Gökhan’s place. The accommodation was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything needed for a pleasant stay. Communication was excellent throughout, and Gökhan was friendly, responsive, and helpful whenever needed. The location was convenient and made it easy to explore the area. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it to other guests.
great place everything is clean and as described and the host is so friendly and responsive definitely worth it

We had a very pleasant stay at this place. The house was comfortable, clean, and well located. The host was friendly and responsive, and the check-in process was easy. We really appreciated the peaceful atmosphere and the overall experience.
Thank you for hosting us. We would happily stay here again and recommend it to other guests.

Gokan was an amazing host always kept checking up asking if we needed anything. House was clean and felt right at home. Locals stores are close from markets to little restaurants don’t have to walk far. I definitely recommend this place if you are a group or even alone just great a great host that will make sure you are comfortable and have everything you need. Thank you Gokhan I will definitely be booking again for my next visit!

description:
A cozy and stylish apartment steps from Istiklal Avenue!

Modern, central, and welcoming – your ideal base in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay!
The apartment was super clean and exactly as described. The location was perfect — just a short walk to Istiklal Street, with plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. The bed sheets were very clean, the kitchen was well equipped, and the bathroom was tidy and comfortable. Check-in was smooth and easy.
The only thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is on the third floor and the stairs are quite narrow, so carrying luggage can be a bit challenging. It would’ve been nice to know this beforehand.
Overall, a great stay — I’d definitely recommend it!

We stayed for 7 nights: it was a good geographical point for explorations of Istanbul, especially for the month of March.
A few things to note, though:
1. The flat is upstairs and is reachable through a narrow staircase; at one point the ceiling is very low, you need to bend to pass. Maybe a challenge with heavy suitcases and for tall people.
2. The room is smaller than you can expect from the photos, there is really little space between the bed and the wall on one side. And the bathroom is tiny, although quite comfortable.
3. It was cold and rainy, the room felt quite warm; but it may get very hot when it's sunny, especially in the kitchen-space.
4. The mattress is firm and stable, this is a big plus-point. The linen is clean, but feels synthetic.
5. The location is quite good in terms of transportation, reaching the centre, eateries and shops. The small street is quiet, but can be muddy or dusty, depending on the weather.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is great, and everything I needed was close by. The host was very friendly and responsive, which made the experience even better. I would happily stay here again!”

This studio apartment was the perfect base for our trip to Istanbul. Located a short walk from Istiklal Street, it made exploring the city easy. Despite being central, it's in a quiet spot, so we rested well without noise issues. The interior is beautifully designed — compact, yet thoughtfully arranged. Ideal for two people. The bed was comfortable, and the space felt warm and welcoming. We appreciated the well-equipped kitchen, which allowed us to cook a few meals. The Wi-Fi was strong and reliable, which was great since we needed to work online. The air conditioning worked perfectly, keeping the apartment cool on warm days. The host was responsive, friendly, and provided clear check-in instructions and local tips, which made everything smooth. Overall, a great place for anyone wanting to be close to the city’s heart while enjoying the comfort and convenience of a well-run Airbnb. Highly recommended!

As a host myself, I understand how important ratings are, so I genuinely wanted to leave max score. Unfortunately, the cleanliness and maintenance were disappointing.
Upon arrival, I found hair everywhere - floor, bed, walls. The towels and the bed sheets were old and worn, there was no coffee, the shower and shower enclosure were damaged, there was a noticeable sewage smell from the bathroom, and the toilet had heavy limescale buildup that looked very unhygienic.
The housekeeping was THE issue. A dirty bucket of water and a mop were left in the hallway throughout my stay, and the dryer was still full of bed linen from previous guests. It felt as though the apartment had not been properly prepared. I would honestly rate the cleaning service 0.
The apartment itself was beautifully furnished though, every centimeter of the space was well optimised.
This property has great potential but the host needs to address the cleanliness and the maintenance issues.
All the best,
Zhani

Eve geldiğimizde ilk dikkat çeken şey temizlikti; ev tertemizdi, mis gibi kokuyordu ve her şey özenle hazırlanmıştı. Fotoğraflardaki görünümle tamamen uyumluydu hatta birçok detayıyla beklentimizi bile aştı. Konumu, rahatlığı ve düzeni sayesinde kendimizi çok kısa sürede evimizde gibi hissettik.
Hem evin kalitesi hem de ev sahibinin kibarlığı ve misafirperverliğiyle son derece memnun ayrıldık. Kesinlikle gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ediyorum. Bir sonraki gelişimizde tereddütsüz tekrar burada kalmak isteriz. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Value for money, convenient location. Lots of restaurants, bars and shops. Walking distance to metro and ferries.
I only stayed one night, all was ok.

description:
Welcome to our cozy stone-and-wood cabin by the creek in the heart of Şile!
Just a 15-minute walk to Ayazma Beach, this peaceful riverside home offers a truly relaxing escape. Wake up to the sound of birds in the morning and enjoy your coffee with a view of the river.
In the garden, you can light a fire or barbecue under the stars. You might even spot turtles in the stream — feel free to feed them or try your luck at fishing.

reviews.text: 2 gün konakladık, her şey fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Gayet sıcak ve huzurlu bir mekan. Oldukça güvenli bir konumda bulunuyor. Yakınlarda birçok market vs var rahatlıkla sırt çantanızı alıp gelebilirsiniz. Konakladığımız en temiz evlerden biriydi. Özellikle TV ve internet çok kullanmasak da oldukça hızlı ve kullanışlıydı. Eğer yağmurlu havalarda konaklayacaksanız tutuşturucu jel veya kuru çıra getirmekte fayda var. Her ne kadar evde yakacak olsa da nemden dolayı işleri biraz zorlaştırabilir. Banyodaki su sıcak ve tazyikli rahatça kullanabilirsiniz. Ev çok soğuk olmuyor ama üşürseniz klima gayet iyi ısıtıyor. Yatak odası ısınsın istiyorsanız biraz beklemeniz gerekebilir. Mutfakta da ihtiyacınız olacak neredeyse her şey mevcut. Her şey için teşekkürler Duygu Hanım.

Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Duygu Hanım ilgili ve hızlı dönüş yapıyor. Bahçeyi sevdik fakat dere kenarı olduğu için geceleri çok fazla kurbağa sesi var. Bahçede yemek yerken etraftaki kediler çok rahatsız ediyor. Kedi maması alarak gitmeniz tavsiyedir. İyi bir mangal vardı ancak Çiğ nedeniyle ateş yakmakta ve harlamakta zorlandık kömür, çıra ve yakmalık odun almak gerekiyor. Temizliğe gelince en çok önemsediğimiz konu buydu. Maalesef beklediğimiz kadar temiz değildi. Özellikle girişteki alandaki tozlar ve oturma odasındaki koltuktaki saç telleri rahatsız ediciydi. Ayrıca koltuk minderleri arasından sigara çıktı. Bu da evin biz gelmeden önce iyi temizlenmediğini gösteriyor. İlk gün elektrik süpürgesini çalıştırmak zorunda kaldık. 2. günümüzde yan villadaki tatilciler çok gürültü yaptı ve gece açtıkları müzik sesinden rahatsız olduk. Banyo temizdi, duş almakta zorluk yaşamadık. Fakat banyodaki ayna çok alçak kalmış, kendimizi görmek için eğilmek zorunda kaldık.
Her şeyden çok memnun kaldık gayet temiz ve gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayacağım bir yer. Ev ve bahçe aynı görsellerdeki gibiydi. Duygu hanım çok ilgili bir ev sahibiydi teşekkürler.

Biz 2 gün kaldık ve çok memnun ayrıldık. Bahçesi çok huzurluydu. Plaja çok yakındı ev. Duygu Hanım çok tatlı birisi çok anlayışlı ve çok iyi bir ev sahibiydi, kendisine teşekkür ederiz. Ateş çukuru yaktık, barbeküsü vardı mangal yaktık. Müziğimizi açtık rahat rahat kaldık. Yeniden gelmeyi kesinlikle düşünürüm 🌸

It's an amazing place which is very close to the centre of the town but also in a very quiet street, peaceful, great for relaxing.
The house was very clean and has all the necessary amenities
The host, Duygu Hanım, was very friendly and always responsive. She recommended local places to eat and was willing to help with sourcing firewood.
I would definitely come back!

description:
✨ A Historical and Fascinating Accommodation in Galata ✨
Feel the spirit of Istanbul in this private house where history and modern comfort meet. Enjoy this unique city with your family…

reviews.text:
I can only fully recommend Emin's place. It is absolutely gorgeous and you feel right at home and relaxed once you enter. It gives you this warm feeling, that is quite seldom. Everything was perfectly clean (10/10)! Not one stain or issue. The place is newly done and it has been done so with good taste. You will enjoy the light in the flat. It even has a tiny balcony. Emin was also extremely helpful with the check-in (even carried up my suitcase) and was always easy to reach whenever a problem arose.
The bed and couch are quite comfortable and so are the chairs. The kitchen is basic but got everything you need.
The location is the absolute best thing. The Kumbaraci street is steep but extremely lovely with all the small craft shops and some cafés. You're also very close to the T1 station and the Karaköy pier. It is by far the best possible location for discovering Istanbul.
The price is absolutely fair, as you are getting a professionally managed flat that is in the best condition!

We had a really nice stay at Emin’s place. He was very friendly, responsive and flexible, and clearly cares about making his guests feel welcome.
The apartment was clean and looked just like the photos. The location is great, only a few minutes’ walk from the T1 tram, with lots of restaurants, cafés and other places nearby. The Wi-Fi, TV and kitchen all worked well, and everything was as expected.
The only thing to keep in mind is that you can hear some traffic from the street, so light sleepers might notice it. But that’s the trade-off for being in such a central location.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend Emin’s place.

Emin’s place is absolutely beautiful and the location is unbeatable. You can walk to almost all the main attractions, and there are so many cute places to eat just steps away. The apartment itself is spotless and the bed is incredibly comfortable — perfect for relaxing after a long day of exploring.
One thing to keep in mind is that the unit is on the third floor and there are over 70 steps. But honestly, since you’re out all day, it’s not a big deal. Plus, my friend found a great trick: take the stairs using the smaller end of each step — it makes the climb way less tiring!
Overall, the charm, comfort, and perfect location make the stairs totally worth it. Highly recommend!

It was absolutely amazing staying at this apartment and Emin is such a great and welcoming host.
One of the best part of this location is ofc the location. It’s very close to all restaurants and stores as well as to the tram&bus station. The place itself looks better than on the photos and have more that everything for short as well as long stay. If we needed something, Emin provided us with all necessary information or stuff at the same day!
As we stayed for a month there during our workation, the only one thing that sometimes was missing is the speed of the internet but if you are travelling as a tourist, the WiFi is more than enough to use for movies, social media etc. :)
This place is definitely must-to-stay is you are looking for unique and Turkish style place, the best location in the nice neighbourhood, a nice communication with the host and a great experience in Istanbul! Thanks to Emin for creating such a great atmosphere

Accurate pictures and description, great host, super clean. On a charming street, great close food options. Great location for exploring Istanbul in every direction, with bus and tram stop 2 mins away, and Sishane metro station 10 mins away (up a steep hill). The building is close to a busy intersection in a lively area, so there was some street noise - but we slept fine with earplugs. Emin kindly let us check in early after a last-minute flight change - thank you Emin!

description: Just 5 minutes from Taksim Square, this modern 3-bedroom apartment offers stunning city views from the kitchen! Located on the first floor, it’s accessible with only a few stairs . Enjoy unlimited Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and a cozy living space with everything you need for a comfortable stay. Perfectly blending convenience and comfort, this is the ideal spot for your Istanbul getaway!

reviews.text: Host was wonderful, very responsive and helpful. Bed and sofa is comfortable and everything looked exactly like the photos. Very good kitchen and amenities. However, sound proofing is not great and we can hear loud stomping and screeching sounds from above. Host tried his best to resolve it so I'm thankful for that. Location-wise, though it is indeed close to Taksim, the steep slopes and lack of street light makes it quite difficult to get to the place. Quite tiring and feels quite eerie at night too. Was hard for my parents and me as a light sleeper 😓 Regardless, wonderful and friendly host who replies really fast!

We stayed at this apartment for five nights and had a wonderful experience. The location is excellent—just a 5-minute walk from Taksim and Istiklal Street, with plenty of coffee shops, restaurants, and stores nearby.
The apartment was spacious, very clean, and exactly as shown in the photos. It had everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
A special thank you to Ozgur, who was an amazing host. From the very beginning, he arranged our airport pickup and was always available to help with anything we needed, including shopping recommendations and local assistance. He was responsive, kind, and made us feel very welcome.
We truly enjoyed our stay and will definitely come back the next time we visit Istanbul. Everything was perfect. Thank you so much, Ozgur!

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The location is perfect — just a short walk to Taksim and close to many shops and restaurants. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for a pleasant stay. I especially enjoyed the city view from the kitchen.
The hosts were welcoming and made the check-in process easy. Communication was smooth and they were always available if I had questions. I’d happily stay here again next time I’m in Istanbul.

🇹🇷
