Ev çok temiz ve rahattı, burada geçirdiğim tatil en huzurlu tatillerimden biri oldu. Özellikle mutfaktaki pencere çok keyifliydi; öğleden sonraları orada çay içmek gerçekten ayrı bir zevkti.
🇨🇦
I rented this house for three nights and four days, and I was very pleased with the hospitality, the location, and the amenities. The host was always available and made sure all our needs were taken care of. The house was very clean and comfortable, and it gave me one of the most relaxing holidays I’ve ever had. I especially loved the kitchen window sitting there in the afternoons and enjoying a cup of tea was truly delightful.

Our stay was fantastic. Spacious, clean, fantastic kitchen, good beds, nice and warm. A 5min walk to Taksim Square and to metro/bus. Communication with the host(s) went smoothly and we could even leave our luggage until the afternoon on our last day 🙏🏻. Recommendable place!

description: My place is suitable for couples, business travelers, and families (with kids). My place is within walking distance of sultanahmete and the Grand Bazaar.com is a comfortable apartment where you will feel at home and in terms of comfort

reviews.text:
Had booked the 3rd floor flat with kitchen and private terrace. There are 2 doors, one going into 2 rooms and bathroom and other for kitchen and terrace. The kitchen door cannot be locked but it's safe.
There was no elevator which we already knew when booking. It was a bit of task to take the luggage to 3rd floor. The main room is bit small than expected. The apartment is in residential locality and to get to the main tram line on Divan Yolu, one has to climb a STEEP slope through a commercial area. It was a shock the first day. However the route to reach the nearest Cemberlitas tram stop is not so steep and we got used to it in a day.
Stayed 5 nights and eventually loved it. The location is very close to the main places, both Grand Bazaar and Sultanahmet. Place is very clean and well kept by Susan. Mehmet was very helpful with any information and booking the transport. Good, friendly guy to talk to.
The neighbourhood was very safe and we could be out till 11pm. We were happy with the amenities, getting a washing machine at the end of our trip to Turkey, was very useful. Stay was definitely comfortable and no complaints whatsoever.
Definitely would recommend the place to others. It's good value with clean accommodation and excellent location.

We felt that the best place to stay in Istanbul is in the Fahit district based on what we had read and been told. The apartment was simple but clean and has all the needed amenities. The rooftop terrace is a nice extra with good views of the water from that level. Walking around the immediate area one feels like you are in a real Istanbul neighborhood and not a tourist district. Nearby restaurants served good tasty food at reasonable prices. There is no elevator if a prospective guest had significant leg problems but it was just fine with us. All in all a place we would stay again and would recommend.

Location of the place is very good. 10-15 min to the main attractions. Despite of that you won't hear any noises from the outside. Apartment is clean and spacious. Wi-Fi was working as expected. Mehmet and his co workers were very helpful and friendly. Additionaly there are great places to eat near by! We'll be recommending this place to our friends. Thank you guys!

We thought there was two beds however it’s one bed and two sofa beds. However the sofa bed is comfortable. The whole apartment is spacious and in the best location. 24.7 front desk too. Wifi was very low but overall a great stay

I want to thank the host Mehmet and also Ayvaz and Suzanne who met us and were in contact all our staying in Istanbul. The apartment is really great: enough space for 3 or 4 persons, a big and comfortable bathroom, a kichen with all quipment, rooms with comfortable sofas and a bed. And of course, terrace! It was reaily amazing to have breakfast outside with a view of the Bosphorus! The flat is easy to find. If you ask people about Feiza apartment, they know about it and show the way. It is close to all main places of interest and the tram line.There are a lot of various shops and cafes near by. So I definitely recommend to stay at this apartment!

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Ulvi was a wonderful host from start to finish. Communication was smooth, clear and friendly throughout our stay. The apartment was exactly as described — clean, comfortable and well-equipped. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly. We truly enjoyed our time here and felt very welcome. The check-in process was easy and Ulvi was always responsive whenever we had questions. Would definitely recommend this place and hope to stay again. Thank you, Ulvi!

Ulvi's place is very nice. It's clean, spacious and bed was comfortable. Location is great ... close to Galata Tower, Istikal Street and tram station Tophane as well. It is safe area too.
Ulvi is also great host, very responsive and wants to help. I had trouble with taxi driver dropping me off at wrong location and Ulvi stepped in right away and came to pick me up. Very much appreciated!
I recommend Ulvi's place. It's very good value too.

This was one of the worst experiences we have ever had. When we arrived at the address, Ulvi suddenly told us that the apartment was not available, even though we had made the booking a long time in advance and had contacted him beforehand about early check-in. We were left standing on the street in the hot sun, exhausted from our journey and not knowing what we were going to do.
Ulvi eventually found another apartment for us, but it was completely different . It was an attic on the top floor near Taksim Square, in terrible condition and clearly not maintained. The floors were water-damaged and the whole place looked like it was falling apart.
At night, there was extremely loud music until 5 AM, so loud that the walls were shaking and we could barely sleep.
We also booked an airport transfer through Ulvi, and the driver was falling asleep while driving us. This was extremely dangerous and frightening.
Overall, a horrible experience from beginning to end.

description: Modern Beyoğlu apartment with stunning Golden Horn views. Renovated with exposed brick walls, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, A/C, and fast Wi-Fi. reviews.text:

Although the apartment is small, it offers amazing value for money. It’s comfortable, practical, and perfect for anyone looking for a clean, well-located place at a great price. We would definitely stay here again.

The stay was very comfortable and peaceful, away from noise. The location is excellent, just a 5-minute walk from Galata Tower. The host is a very kind person, quick to respond, and extremely helpful. There is also a bus station nearby, about a 7-minute walk.
The only issues I faced were that the curtains let too much light into the room, and the bathroom water sprayer could use a bit of adjustment.

Perfect stay in every way! The location in is unbeatable, and the WiFi was super fast. The bed was comfortable, the AC worked perfectly, and the host thought of every little detail. It felt like a home away from home. Definitely booking again next time we're in Istanbul.

We didn’t arrive until 4am but when we arrived the manager appeared from opposite to greet us.
Location is absolutely great, so convenient to the main bridge, the metro was a 5 minute walk away.
We walked to the spice market across the bridge which was a 20 minute stroll, we caught the metro to taksim square which is 2 stops away.
The apartment was very clean, the rain shower perfect, really could not have expected more.
Just what we needed.
Thank you!

A great place to stay! Communication with host was excellent from booking to checkout. The apartment was exactly as pictured spotless and well-equipped. The location is perfect for exploring the area, few minutes away from Galata Tower.

The place is calm, quiet, and very family-friendly. There are many shops and fast-food options nearby, all within easy reach. Excellent value for money.
Highly recommended. We would definitely stay here again.

Moussaab is a very helpful, kind, generous, and trustworthy person.
The house is spacious, very clean, and comfortable.
It's a place where you feel right at home. All the necessary equipment is provided. The location is ideal !!
My stay was the best ever, thanks to this accommodation and Moussaab.
Whether you're traveling with family, friends, or alone, I highly recommend this place.

The apartment was tidy, clean, and incredibly comfortable, and I truly felt right at home. It’s also located in a strategic area, very close to the metro line, which made getting around and reaching all the places I wanted to visit quick and effortless.
But what truly sets this experience apart is Musab’s character and his refined hospitality, a generous, courteous person who genuinely cares about his guests’ comfort.
I highly recommend staying with him, and I wouldn’t hesitate for a moment to come back again. Thank you for everything, Musab, you’re an unforgettable host!

We had an absolutely fantastic stay. From the moment we walked in, we were impressed by the space. It's beautifully laid out, feeling both spacious and incredibly cozy—perfect for relaxing after a day out.

The hosts have clearly put a lot of care into this apartment. Highly, highly recommended!

Beyoğlu’s rich history, cultural layers, impressive architecture, and lively atmosphere make it one of Istanbul’s most inspiring districts. It’s a place full of color and excitement, attracting visitors from all around the world.
With our home Jurnal, you can experience this iconic area just like a local. Situated in Asmalı Mescit—the energetic core of Beyoğlu—our apartment places you within moments of its famous nightlife, cozy cafés, and cultural hotspots.

reviews.text:
The apartment was very clean and exactly as shown in the photos. It’s a cute, cozy, and warm place to stay.
There is parking available on the street below, and the metro is just a few minutes away, which makes getting around very convenient. Because of the nearby bars and restaurants, it can get a bit noisy on Saturday nights outside—but that’s just part of staying in Beyoğlu. The host is very responsive and replies quickly. Check-in was also smooth and easy.
Overall, a comfortable stay and a well-located apartment.

First off the location for this apartment is amazing ! If you want to grab a drink just go downstairs corner Irish pub is right there. It was perfect for a night out.

If you are visiting for the first time this apartment is very conveniently located from tram and metro and you can get to most highlights very easily.
Turker was a great host. Very responsive and always got back to us right away.
Highly recommend this place.

The apartment is very spacious, clean and well maintained! I enjoyed my stay at the apartment it is very close to the busy street, Istiklal street. It’s close to bars, cafes and restaurants.
I would recommend it for other guests and would love to stay in it again.
The host is extremely friendly and responsive and made sure our stay was comfortable.

description: Our historic building, built in the late 19th century, is located in one of Istanbul’s most central and prestigious areas. It is just 1 minute walking distance from Istiklal Street, and within easy reach of Kabataş Pier, Galata Tower and all public transport. The area is full of cafés and restaurants, yet safe and quiet. The building is believed to have been built by Armenian and Greek stone masters.

reviews.text: We had a great stay in the beautiful city of Istanbul and would absolutely recommend this Airbnb. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described and pictured. The location was convenient and made it easy to get around. Taksim square a short 10min walk down the main street. Burga was extremely responsive and over-the-top welcoming at check in. We had arrived well before checkin and he made accommodations for us nearby until the flat was prepared. He even organized a taxi to take us to the flat and the cleaner welcomed us and showed us how to use the entry way lock and doors within the flat. This personalized touch kicked off a fantastic week in his beautiful city. The host was extremely accommodating, explaining how to turn various things on/off in the flat. Check out was even smoother with a Mercedes car service, which he organised for us at 4am. If we could give our experience staying in this flat 10 stars, we would! Thank you for showering us with your hospitality.

We had a truly exceptional stay at this beautifully staged apartment — the photos don’t do it justice. The interior is sophisticated and full of character, with elegant seating areas, tasteful decor, and thoughtful touches throughout that made us feel right at home. From the charming exposed brick and vintage piano nook to the stylish living spaces and lovely dining area, every corner of this place was stunning and comfortable.
Communication with the host was smooth and prompt, and check-in was effortless. The space was impeccably clean and beautifully presented — it clearly reflects a high level of care and attention to detail. The location was great for exploring the surrounding neighborhood, with convenient access to local attractions and amenities.

We truly enjoyed our stay in the apartment. The beautiful and tasteful décor in every corner and detail really stood out, with lovely spots perfect for taking photos and creating wonderful memories.
The apartment was very clean and fully equipped with everything one might need, making our stay comfortable and enjoyable.
The hospitality was exceptional, and the owner’s attitude and communication were extremely polite and professional. We would like to extend our special thanks to him for his understanding, cooperation, and support until our departure time.
We will definitely visit again in the future and highly recommend this apartment to family and friends, as it is truly beautiful, well-located, and close to major tourist attractions such as Istiklal Street and Galata Tower.

great place
amazing amenities, great coffee, more beautiful than the photos, a crazy incredible kitchen sink and bathroom shower
responsive friendly host who went out of his way to help us with very early arrival

Plus, the location in Taksim is incredibly central, easy to walk everywhere and very convenient to get around.
Highly recommended. We would happily stay here again.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text: We had a very nice stay. The host was really kind, helpful and always available when we needed anything. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and the cleaning was very good. The location was also great, very close to many tourist attractions, which made it easy for us to explore Istanbul. We enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place. Thank you for everything!

Oda genel olarak temiz ve düzenliydi; ihtiyaç duyulabilecek çoğu şey düşünülmüştü. İki gün boyunca sorunsuz bir konaklama geçirdim. Ev sahibine ve çalışanlara teşekkür ederim. Konum açısından tramvaya çok yakın olmasa da metroya ulaşım iyiydi.

Stuart

description: Located in the heart of Istanbul’s historic Old City, this apartment is ideal for guests who want to explore the city’s most famous landmarks on foot. Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and the Grand Bazaar are all within walking distance. Despite its central location, the apartment offers a calm and comfortable stay.

reviews.text:
Zafer was a very friendly and responsive host. The flat is as described and was quite clean. Some of the kitchen items and furniture look a little old and worn, but nothing that bothered us too much.
The apartment is about a 15-minute walk from the metro, and the route is uphill, so we sometimes took an Uber when we were in a rush. On the other hand, it is within walking distance of several famous mosques and palaces, which was very convenient.
The neighborhood feels quite traditional and is not very touristy, which we actually liked. At times, we did notice people looking at us while we were walking around, but we did not feel uncomfortable.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and felt that the apartment offered good value for the price we paid.

Hotel Review
I had a great stay at this hotel. The location was excellent, making it easy to get around and explore the area. The room was clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff were friendly and helpful throughout our stay.
Overall, I was very happy with the experience and felt that the hotel offered good value for money. I would definitely consider staying here again and would recommend it to others visiting the area.
the place as it was shown on the picture it was clean no bad smells and the location was perfect if you want to have access to Kapali Carshi. 10/10

We had a wonderful stay here! The location is perfect, situated in a convenient area with plenty of great local restaurants within walking distance. The host was incredibly welcoming, fair, and genuine, making sure we had everything we needed. I would definitely stay here again!

This was a really easy five-star. Extremely clean and well put together apartment. The host is incredible: great hospitality, very welcoming, and super helpful. Easy check-in, stored our luggage after checkout, and was always available for assistance. Highly recommended.

reviews.text:

Thanks for a great stay!

Wonderful stay in Beyoğlu. The apartment is modern, quiet, comfortable, and very clean. The location could not be better, with easy access to the metro, ferries, restaurants, cafés, and great walking areas.
The staff were excellent. Hülya and Ahmet were especially kind, helpful, and responsive, which made everything easy from check-in to checkout. There is also an excellent family-run restaurant directly across the street.
Overall, a perfect base for Istanbul. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

What an incredible stay in Istanbul! Ahmed and Julia were absolutely wonderful hosts from start to finish , quick to respond, full of great local tips, and so easy to communicate with throughout our stay. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described, making it the perfect base for exploring the city.
We really appreciated how attentive and welcoming they were, it’s clear they put a lot of care into making sure guests feel at home. Would happily stay again and recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

I had a really nice stay! The Airbnb was very clean, comfortable, and well maintained. Hülay was kind and made the check-in experience wonderful. The location was also great close to Taksim and convenient for getting around and exploring Istanbul. Everything went smoothly, and I really enjoyed my stay. I would definitely recommend it!

We come to Istanbul and this neighborhood often for the weekend and this is the best place we have stayed so far. description:
Enjoy your stay in this newly renovated (spring 2026) historical apartment in Galata, Beyoğlu. The building itself has a 100-year history, renovated entirely in 2005.

The building has an elevator; however, since it stops on half floors, access to the apartment requires only a short half-flight of stairs.

All the rooms are equipped with an air conditioner.

This property can accommodate up to 5 people.

We wanted to offer our guests a historic atmosphere with modern design in a prime location

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment and would highly recommend it.
The location is excellent, just a short walk from Galata Tower. If it’s your first time in Istanbul, it’s a perfect place to stay. Most of the main attractions are within walking distance, and the ferry terminal is also very close.
The apartment itself is modern, clean, and very comfortable. It has everything you could possibly need, from a washing machine with laundry detergent provided to a fully equipped kitchen. The interior is beautiful and thoughtfully done, making it a great choice for anyone who appreciates aesthetics as much as comfort.
The host was incredibly kind and accommodating. We were allowed both an early check-in and a late check-out, which made our trip much more convenient. Communication was always quick, friendly, and helpful.
Overall, a 10/10 experience. We would be absolutely happy to stay here again.

I would highly recommend this stay. If you’re debating between options or even unsure about the area — don’t. Just book it.
This was honestly our favourite Airbnb stay. The apartment was beautiful, very clean, and had everything we needed. The street is quiet, the building is well kept and has an elevator which we learned is not in the majority of buildings, and the location is excellent.
The hosts were amazing — very responsive, accommodating, and truly went above and beyond for us. Their kindness made the whole experience feel easy and comfortable.
It’s also in a great spot — close to multiple transit lines making it easy to get around town, great restaurants all around, and just steps from Galata Tower. Would absolutely stay here again.

Apartment was great! Modern, comfortable and clean. AC was super effective. The rainfall shower was nice.
Location is perfect, close to Galata tower and Istiklal, but still on a quiet street. Tram and ferry is a short walk downhill. M2 metro is even closer. Lots of good restaurants and rooftops with nice views around.
After a long day of walking you can take the F2 funicular up from Karaköy, and walk 200m downhill comfortably.
The apartment is lacking a bit in soundproofing, especially in the bedroom towards the street. However, being a quiet street, this didnt bother us much.
If i am going to Istanbul again, i would definetily book this apartment!

Having arrived at Sishane Metro station we could not locate 'Exit 1' - we suggest visitors are told to follow signs for Istiklal.
That said, this apartment is perfect!! The owners have really taken immense care to ensure that you have everything you need for a comfortable stay. And the quality of everything in the apartment is first class - we particularly loved the bathroom/shower. It was also very clean.
So we would recommend Alp and Inci's apartment without reservation. It is in the best spot for visiting Istanbul because - 1) it's close to Galata Tower (great for walking navigation!), 2) it's close to Sishane (great for access by Metro from the airport), 3) it's close to the wonderful Tunel! (easy to get down to the ferries, the T1 tramline and thus over to Sultanahmet, Bazaars etc etc) and 4) Istiklal Street (shops, restaurants, bars) is just 200m away. The BEST APARTMENT in the BEST SPOT!

This was one of the best places we stayed, clean, modern and very comfortable. Alp and Inci were extremely responsive and offered to help with anything we might need. The apartment is in a great location close to transport, Galata Tower and lots of lovely places to eat. We loved it and would have booked it again for our next time in Istanbul but it’s already booked. I really recommend it as a great place to stay.

reviews.text:

Evde her türlü mutfak aleti ve gereci fazlasıyla olduğundan kendi yemeğinizi rahat hazırlıyor ve yiyebiliyorsunuz, arkadaşlarla sofra kurabiliyorsunuz. Çalışma masası koskocamandı, onda da rahatça işimi gördüm. Her açıdan çok memnun kaldım. Manzara da muazzamdı. Bir tek doğa içinde olunca sineklere hazır gitmek gerek. Onun için de önden bilgi veriliyor zaten. Genel olarak istisnai bir deneyimdi. Her şey için teşekkürler.

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev son derece temiz, düzenli ve özenliydi. Manzarası ise gerçekten muhteşemdi! Konaklama boyunca ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şey düşünülmüş. Evde hiçbir eksik hissetmedik. Her detayın özenle hazırlandığı belli oluyor. Bizim için her şey kusursuzdu. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye eder, tekrar konaklamayı kesinlikle isteriz. 🌿✨

description:
The flat is 60 sqm. has a 1 double bed or 2 separate single beds( optional) for 2 people. There is 1 bedroom, 1 living room with a fully equiped kitchen; bathroom and Wc.
Clean white sheets,towels, duvet,mini-bar, kettle,cooker,micro-wave oven, plasma tv.Air conditioner and washing machine.
Hair dryer and shampoo are available in the bathroom
High connection WİFİ
TV has free access to many world channels.

reviews.text:
This was our first visit to turkey and so we wanted to stay and feel the real turkey. Staying with Ozlem fulfilled our aspirations.
Her 200+ years old traditional house, uphill Fener in Balat, was an experience in itself. Walking along the stone-paved street in the old city gave the real feel of a laid back ‘village’. Palation house is located at convenient walking distance from Fener bus stop near the corniche. Frequent buses take you to Eminonu/Spice market and local transport center (bus, trams, ferry, metro).
Ozlem has retained the old Greek house in its original charm and authenticity. The wooden spiral stairs leading to our room was an enjoyable ‘exercise’!
We were placed at the topmost floor, below the terrace. The terrace overlooks the Golden Horn where one could find a beautiful view of the Seagulls and the Sea-planes early in the morning!
The layout of the rooms was so cosy and yet retained privacy – perfect for our family of 3! Our grownup son was housed in a separate room with a pantry and an antique dining table adding to our comfort during the stay. Bathroom and the toilet were clean, well kept.
The attendant was always helpful and made innumerable trips up and down the stairs which glee.
Apart from making us comfortable, Ozlem and her companion were so helpful sharing information about the city. They arranged for us moonlight cruise at discounted prices – but unfortunately due to lack of time we could not avail of it.

Ozlem, the wonderful, charming host was so kind to keep some of our ‘excess baggage’ with her until we returned a week later to collect!
Thus, we highly recommend one to stay with her and feel at home in this historical place!

Ozlem is helpful in many ways, Ozlem is always around when you need her and she respond quick if you need any help. Me and my wife really like her and I will go back there next time for sure. Very Few minutes walk to local coffee shops, small restaurants and 50 meter walk to local small convenience store. Murat is a young guy working there and he’s the funniest guy ever.
Shower was warm, towels were clean, bed smelled fresh and the AC was great. Ozlem, me and my wife love you.

We loved it here. The bed (top floor apartment) is HUGE and really comfy, the shower is HOT and powerful. The view from the Terrace is beautiful and the neighbourhood is really interesting and friendly with some lovely places for breakfast / lunch / dinner / coffee etc.

We stayed in the top floor apartment which was quite small but perfect for a couple who are going to eat out and not cook. There are facilities for cooking but they are more suited for making tea and easy things like breakfast. But with so many interesting and delicious places to eat locally it's better to eat out.

We loved Forno Balat for breakfast, and Agora for dinner was also amazing. Walking up the hill to Fatih you can find a really interesting neighbourhood to look around. Also there's a little store on the corner of Vodina which sells freshly squeezed pomergranate juice really cheaply - lovely. And a small Kofte restaurant on the main road that runs along the waterfront, amazing kofte there I can't remember the name but if you google balat kofte it comes up on an article called "the good ship meatball" or something on istanbul eats.

The bus to Eminuou is a bit hectic, you have to really wave it down, it won't necessarily pull into the stop - traffic often terrible so maybe quicker to walk. Also the bus station at Eminunou is HECTIC to figure out but trams are easier.

All in all a lovely place and we would come again :) Ozlem and her partner at the house were super helpful booking taxis to airports and suggesting a hammam for us to visit and restaurants to go to.

Özlem's place is great! Centrally located in a hip neighborhood, clean and comfortable. And Özlem could not be a better host. Very keen on helping you feel at home in Istambul. Very highly recommended!

Özlems place was more than what we expected. Very clean, comfortable and nice, located in the best area of istanbul. The host are extremly friendly and kind, and helped us with tips and restaurantes. The location is in a great old area of istanbul with many cafe and siteseeing.
Thank you for everything and good luck!
Gonzalo

description: Hotel Perula located the real heart of old istanbul, near hippodrome square and sultanahmet tram station. Sultanahmet Blue Mosque, St. Sophia (Hagia Sofia) Museum, Topkapi Palace, Archaeological Museum, Basilica Cistern, Time Column, Hippodrome and Obelisk, Grand Covered Bazaar ...only a few historical monuments in walking distance.

reviews.text:
Отель с удобным расположением в самом центре Стамбула. Удобные кровати. Сытный завтрак с прекрасным видом на Босфор и Голубую мечеть. Ежедневная и тщательная уборка. Горничная почему-то принесла нам еще две бутылки воды в мини-бар, хотя вода там уже была:))) Вежливые и отзывчивые администраторы, готовые всегда помочь.
Прекрасное соотношение цена/качество. Рекомендую!
Hotel is conveniently located in the heart of Istanbul. Comfortable beds. Hearty breakfast with beautiful view of Bosphorus and Blue Mosque. Daily and thorough cleaning. Hotelmaid brought another two bottles of water in the mini-bar for some reason, even though the water was already there :))) Polite and responsive administrators, always ready to help.
Excellent value for money. I recommend!

My overnight stay at Hotel Perula was without any problems and a very pleasant one. I would highly recommend them.
From arriving and finding a small welcome gift in the room, to arranging a taxi to leave again, one feels right at home.
The hotel is located centrally, close to Çemberlitaş tram stop, behind the Sultanahmet and walking distance from the Grand Bazaar (be sure to visit the Basilica Cistern which was a personal highlight and an easily overlooked landmark).
The staff are very friendly and helpful. I would like to give a special thanks to Mahmud for his help, making you feel welcome and sightseeing tips.
The pictures do not do the view from the rooftop enough justice.
Great breakfast, comfortable and clean rooms. I arrived in the middle of Ramadan and even during the evening the room was quiet.
They offer storage for your baggage after check-out.
I will be sure to return here when visiting Istanbul the next time.

Location is amazing! Blue mosque, Hippodrom square and Aya Sophia are about 5 min walking distance. Pictures of the great view from the terrace is also accurate. Breakfast was also nice. We only wished that the place was cleaner. Our towels were grey and the whole place was dusty. If you don’t care much about cleanliness, you will fully enjoy your stay. After all, there is so much to see, you don’t need to spend a lot of time in the hotel and the price per night is not high. If you do, maybe look for other hotels? There is a ton of them in the area.
Hamit was a wonderful host. Clean hotel room, friendly staff, great price, and walkable distance to many historical sights and tourist attractions. I would recommend this hotel and stay again!

We had an amazing stay at this beautiful Airbnb in Istanbul! The hotel was spotless, stylish, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location couldn't have been better just a short walk from the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia, making it so easy to explore the city's most iconic landmarks.
The neighbourhood was lively yet peaceful, with plenty of great restaurants, cafés, and shops nearby. The host was welcoming, responsive, and made sure everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out.
If you're looking for a clean, comfortable, and perfectly located place to stay in Istanbul, I highly recommend this Airbnb. We had a fantastic experience and would definitely stay here again on our next visit!

description: Right in the heart of Arnavutkoy, this place is ideal for any family!

reviews.text:
I cannot express how much I was amazed at this stay.
This apartment is so beautiful and located in a great spot away from the tourist crowd. The location still has plenty of good restaurants, bars, and grocery stores. It is close to the bridge, so it takes just 40 mins on Friday to get to Sabiha airport on Friday.
The view. Pictures will not express how great the view is. So incredible. I was sitting in front of a window and could not do anything else apart from staring outside. Bosphorus, ships, birds, sky, and mosque are all beautiful. I have no words to describe the feeling.
The apartment. All is great. You have all you need to live there for the long term. The place has a bathroom, washing/drying machine, bedroom, kitchen, work zone, and couch to sit and stare at Bosphorus. People that live in this apartment take care of the place - it is very stylish and in perfect condition. You must go up about 50 stairs to find this hidden gem. I had two suitcases, and going up was no fun, but believe me - you will forget this once you were inside.
Location. Arnavutköy is an excellent place to live in a quiet and still modern area. I am not a local, but during my two-day stay, I liked this location. Maybe 20+ restaurants and bars (pancakes, Italian, European, Turkish cuisine), a nice place to walk by the Bosphorus or take a boat.
The host is also amiable and responsive. For example, he helped me to find some dishes and explained how to get there, where the keys are, etc. Aras speaks English, and you can text him and ask what you need.
Man, I would go for it if I could buy this place.

One of the best airbnb experiences i have ever had! Had the pleasure of staying a month and I must say it exceeded expectations! Modern unit with an impeccable view of the Bosporus. Extremely comfortable bed + furniture and the design of the apartment is tasteful and chic. Kitchen had all the essentials to cook. Very spacious. Many units in Istanbul do not have a dryer so it was a nice touch to have one available!
Arnavutköy has everything within walking distance. Great nightlife, restaurants and markets. Shelley and A Bit of Eggo were my go to spots for breakfast. Fistik kebap was my favorite late night spot. Xunta had the tastiest cocktails. Countless tasty seafood restaurants as well!
Aras was great at communication and was always very receptive to any questions I had. Would highly recommend to stay here and I hope to be back soon :)

The place is absolutely stunning. The view is magnificent. The house feels spacious, cozy, and homey. The location is wonderful — you are in Arnavutkoy which is one of the most exciting neighborhoods and town and a short walk away from many stunning spots in Bebek. Aras has incredible communication and is a very accommodating and helpful host. Of all of the Airbnb’s I have stayed in, this might be top of my list.

Aras is a great host. He was so responsive during my stay. The place is just up the lively Arnavutkoy. The neighborhood is amazing so I truly enjoyed my stay. The view from the living room is breathtaking. I highly recommend it.

The apartment building is on a hill side, so expect to walk uphill for a bit and climb stairs (about 40 steps) to reach the building. Great neighborhood with old Istanbul architecture nearby and wonderful cafes, bars and quaint shops.

description:
I am a digital nomad living in a campervan and hiring my flat. @nomadinacamper

Flat is only 15 mins to Istanbul Airport and 30 mins to city center. Bright and spacious dublex flat with a big terrace.

Indoor, outdoor pool, sauna, fitness, parking, 24 hours security. 1 min to bus station, supermarket, pharmacy and restaurants.
Gokturk is an elite residential area with best restaurants, cafés as well as lake and forest. Easy to access to city center by metro,bus or private taxis (5-10€

reviews.text: The apartment is a nice, cosy apartment. It has a nice kitchen with a forest view - not too big but just enough size. Upstairs, there is a comfortable double bed and a nice balcony with a nicer view. The apartment and bathrooms were clean when we arrived. The apartment complex is a quiet one with friendly neighbours, security 24/7 and parking. Once you get out the complex, you can easily access to many grocery stores and restaurants. Carrefour supermarket just outside is a great convenience. The neighbourhood is very crowded with a busy traffic. So, one may not enjoy the walking part itself to other parts of Gokturk, but the accessibility to immediate needs is great. Inner streets are more peaceful to walk. Broader area includes the Belgrade Forest (extremely big) with public entry points nearby and it's easy to reach to more central neighborhoods of Istanbul via public transportation. Selim was a great host with a smooth communication and responded timely to our small requests

Gokturk a premium location in Turkey very close to the airport very modern and relatively new and fresh residential area; at the same time very close to Belgrade forest with fresh morning walks on a magnificent Parkur and at the same time very close to the Black Sea . The Turkish Residents of Göktürk area are very elite and modern ; you can find on a walking distance cafes restaurants bookshops local markets shops ; it is a fully equipped area etc... .
Selim's Apartment was very convenient ; across the street their is a bus stop that you can use to go anywhere in Istanbul .
The apartment was in a very clean tidy complex ; very safe with many security personnel on the entrance that are also very helpful and you will need few hours to feel its like home .
the apartment is very clean comfortable you will find everything that you might think of . Selim did not forget anything :) He was very helpful and reachable to reply for any inquiry .
I do highly recommend the Area and especially Selim's apartment ; you will definitely feel good and feel its like your own home .

We have spent a wonderful week at Selim’s apartment. The place has all the necessary amenities and a fully equipped kitchen. One great feature is a terrace, where we had romantic dinners watching the stars and airplanes. The area is very nice with many small shops and restaurants. It is perfectly situated outside of crowded center but just 30-40 minutes drive from it. Same distance to some great beaches. Selim was a great host: friendly and helping. We had a great experience and wished we could stay longer.

Selim is a very nice guy, very helpful and kind! The place was pretty clean, stylish and it included everything we needed. The house also has a huge smart tv, pool and gym. Very close to the kemer country club which is why we chose it. The price is great for the amenities of the house. Definitely recommend!
Great location great place great host

description:
Welcome! Enjoy my cozy bright third bedroom with balcony in hip Cihangir/Taksim area. Close to tons of shops, bars, restaurants, and cafes. This neighborhood is the perfect home base to explore Istanbul.
A friend of mine and I are living in the flat and we are both easy-going and laid back guys. We both work in hospitality. we can offer you a spectacular Istanbul stay.
The apartment is located in the 5th floor and there’s NO elevator.

reviews.text:
The room is very nice, the bed is comfy, it's clean and it has a small terrace. The wifi is good and there is hot water. Onder and his roommate Zeyid were very nice, they are great hosts. They let me leave my luggage when I arrived earlier and also when I left later than check out time. Just be aware that their apartment is on the 5th floor and there is no elevator. Zeyid was kind enough to help me with my luggage. It's located near Taksim square.
Highly recommended.

all is good. room comfortable and clean. host very kind and helpful, also let me make my own breakfast at their kitchen. Great location, accessible and walkable to many great places. Super recomended to all travellers.

This is one of the best air bnb I ever used.
Host is very friendly and eager to help guest. He even borrowed me his shoes when I suffered feet hurt.
Location is good as it is close to Taxim square.
One tip for guests. If you want to take a metro from this house to Istanbul international airport, take a bus around the house before take a metro at Gayerett station. Because you have to climb the hill if you want to go to Taxim metro.
This house has everything. Clean bathroom, convenient kitchen, a room with comfortable bed and a fan.
Strongly recommend all the visitors.

This was my second time staying here—the second of many times, hopefully! Onder’s home is always clean, warm, and welcoming, equipped with a washer AND dryer, a warm shower, and a kitchen well-stocked with tea and coffee, which Onder insisted I was welcome to use. The location of his apartment is perfect. It is just a few steps from the taxi station, upstairs from an amazing borek shop, and immediately downhill from Taksim square. I love that Onder is very sensitive and respectful of his guests’ privacy. While you will never feel obligated to socialize, you will be happy if you do; Onder is well-traveled, wise, and a wonderful listener. I am glad to know him!

Onder’s home is always my first choice when I come to Istanbul, so I was stoked to see it available this time around. I always feel so cozy there. The apartment is kept clean and warm. The room is spacious, the bed is very comfortable, a washer and dryer are available. And, the location is as ideal as it gets.. within a little climb to Taksim and Cihangir. Solo female travelers should feel very safe and welcome here. The hosts themselves are always so kind and helpful. They are quite, health-conscious people who respect their guests’ privacy. I look forward to coming back!

description: OUR APARTMENT IS IN THE WALKING DISTANCE TO SULTANAHMETE. CAFES, RESTAURANTS AND MARKETS IN THE AREA. WALKING DISTANCE TO THE CITY

reviews.text: Great choice for your stay in Istanbul. Spacious, location is near from everywhere (touristic area like sultanahmed, ayasofia, grandbazar, sulemaniye, tram station) in walking distance. I can also always rely on their internet since I need it very much for working during my stay. The owner is very nice, help you with anything (pickup, check in, recommendation around). The balcony has a bit glimpse of sultanahmed cami, great place to have your morning tea. Already and would again stay and recommend this place to friends/family if they visiting Istanbul.

Very pleased, exactly as advertised, nice and quiet. Owner very helpful, and he stays right on the premises. He helped us on numerous occasions with directions, times, and even left luggage when we checked out. Location is within walking distance of attractions and near everything. We would certainly come back.
Very comfortable location and good modern flat. Thank you!

L’appartement est très sale et ne se voit pas sur les photos.
Les photos sont prises en sorte qu’on ne le voit pas. Humidité, vaisselles collantes, frigo dégoulinant d’une chose orange, pied de toilette plein d’urine, joints de la douche noir.
L’hôte nous a tout de même remboursé les nuits non passées à l’appartement car nous l’avons quitté avant.
Si vous cherchez un endroit religieux, à fuir ! On entend les voisins baiser jusqu’à 3h du matin ainsi que toute la journée. Musique jusqu’à tard la nuit.
Allez plutôt dans le quartier de la mosquée Fatih pour cela.

Останавливались на 4 недели. Рекомендую! Район не плохой, квартира хорошая . Были небольшие проблемы в квартире, но их быстро исправляли. Хозяин целый день находится в этом же здании, и моментально устраняет проблемы.
Я бы рекомендовал тут оставаться моим знакомым и друзьям.
