reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay and really enjoyed our time here. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was very convenient, and everything we needed was nearby. The host was extremely kind, helpful, and responsive throughout our stay, and Ilhan was also very friendly and helpful whenever we needed anything. We felt very welcome and well looked after. Thank you for the great hospitality! We would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay here again

We had a great stay at Ilhan’s place! The home was exactly as shown in the photos—clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was perfect—quiet yet easily walkable to Istiklal Street and other attractions.
Ilhan was very responsive and ensured everything was perfect for our visit.
The apartment also in the first floor for people who can’t climb

Nice apartment around 15 minutes by walk from Taksim square. Communication with Ilhan was very smooth and she reacted quickly. While it is quiet outside, it gets quite noisy inside the building during weekends. Also the bed is only 1.40-1.50m, which is very small for 2 people (definitely don't book if you're more than 2 people). Don't expect luxury, but a solid, clean apartment - it is really worth the 40 euros we paid per night.

This is my third trip to Istanbul and I was here to take a Turkish course near Taksim, so this location worked well - I could walk to school each morning. There are a lot of bus and taxi options nearby, and a 15 minute walk to Istiklal. There are many local restaurants and stores, so you can support the local economy. The location is a little rough around the edges, but it is a local and active neighborhood, with nice side streets to explore (check out the street art depicting local workers).
The space was safe and secure & İlhan and Resul were always responsive when contacted. The shower, washer, and AC were nice, and the bed and sofa were comfortable. It can sometimes be noisy at night or early in the morning for light sleepers, but usually it was pleasant. Wifi worked well, though I had a handful of issues during 2-week stay, along with a short-term power outage one day, but this a problem everywhere in Istanbul unfortunately! Overall, it was a good experience.

Place was well kept, maintain and exactly as in the picture. Some minor improvement required on the house. The bed slight springy but was ok
Pros:
- close to small supermarket
- utensils were enough for cooking
- Close to nearby bus station for easier commute
- Near to istiklal street (a bit walking required)
Cons:
- slightly far from Taksim metro station when first time arrived from airport. This is due to the hilly road of istanbul (This is when you are choose to walk)
- We experience a slight blackout due to the city power instability but was quickly fixed
Overall was nice place to stay for the price offer😊

description: The accommodation consists of two flats of a freshly renovated historical building. The modern renovation reflects its historical style as well. When these two old and new style come together, the result became inspiring. Our flats are always clean and bright. Here you will feel at home. Taksim square is just 500 m away by walk. The location is just perfect. There are so many restaurants, bars, shops. All rooms get the sunlight. On the third floor you will have big terrace with beautiful view.

reviews.text: Perfect for our 3 families. It was a narrow climb up the stairs. The bathrooms and kitchens were small but functional. Not a luxury apartment or beautiful neighborhood, but a short walk to all of Taxim square’s shops, hotels, and restaurants.

Nursena was very kind and helpful host, the apartments were so clean. The location is only 5 minutes to Taksim, but you need to climb the hills and stairs.
The place is very good and affordable for young pp who are able to clim the narrow and tall stairs in the first and second floors.

Highly recommend! The location is very walkable to Taksim Square and Metro Station, but still just outside the hustle of any major roads, so it’s very peaceful. The flats themselves were clean, with all the amenities needed for a long stay. We were a large group of people (13) but everyone had plenty of space and privacy, with room to spare.
Nursena was SUCH a responsive host, she was so friendly and always available when we needed some assistance.
All in all - this was a fantastic find and I would definitely recommend to anyone traveling with a large group.

Very clean and nice place, suitable for large groups.
The host is kind, communicative and helpful.
It’s a little bit hard to find the building, but it’s in the walking distance to the Taksim Square and all tourist attractions.

The flats are in a very conveniently located. Make sure you enter the street from the Taksim Sq end. Cooking is a bit difficult. In first floor flat the kitchen has a washing machine but no dishwasher, the fridge is very small. In the second floor the kitchen has large fridge and a dishwasher, but hardly any room to cook. The oven is in a room in the third floor. This arrangement makes any cooking very tricky. There is no room where to sit or eat together. Still, well worth the location, and the owner's kindness.

description: Hey. I love airbnb. I have Airbnb experince for 5 years. And i had moved my home, It s my own home. I live alone and have 3 room ;One living room , my bedroom, your bedroom, kitchen and bathroom. You can cook your food , It s a safe and light Apartment very central location. U can walk anywhere which is historical part of istanbul. Supermarket grocery pharmacy Hospital clubs cafes and bars are near. You can read my profile comment. I have wifi, coffee tea machıne, iron, kitchen equiments

reviews.text:
We traveled to Istanbul for 3 days. Loved the house, great quiet location. The apartment was very easy to find thanks to very detailed instructions from the owner.
Ruhi was very friendly. We had a very late check-in, despite this, Ruhi was in touch with us.
The room was exactly as described, there were very comfortable beds, nice bathroom and shower.

Great stay all around in a very convenient location easy to commute anywhere in central Istanbul. Ruhi is a genuinely kind and caring host with excellent communication pre arrival, and suggested visiting the nearby Rahmi Koç Museum which was brilliant.
The apartment itself is on the 3rd floor without a lift so be aware of stairs if that is an issue, and the kitchen and bathroom are very tiny small spaces which may not be suitable for everyone. Neither of these things bothered me at all and Ruhi's friendliness and hospitality was far more than expected. An added bonus just at the end of the street behind the mosque is an authentic Turkish bath and sauna which was a great experience at a non tourist price.... €10 for 1 hour sauna, scrub, and 10 minute masage.

Ruhi has a warm, easy-going personality. I felt very welcome and comfortable in his home. The guest room has a door onto a small balcony and windows on the adjacent side, so there is almost always a little breeze coming through the room. If it is hot and humid, he has a very effective air conditioning unit in the living room. A street with a few coffee shops (Noir Pit makes the best espresso-based drinks in the area, in my opinion) is about a fifteen-minute walk away but note that it goes up a fairly high hill. The Galata Tower is another ten minutes’ walk from there (a relatively level walk) and around it is a large area filled with all kinds of shops and restaurants. I was there in July 2023 and by late afternoon it was a very busy area with a fun atmosphere.

First first of all, Ruhi is extremely nice and he's the perfect host! His flat was very easy to find and the arrival was facilitate thanks to all the instructions he gave me. It's clean, confortable and located in a popular and friendly neighborhood. You even find a hamam just 3 mn walking which is not touristy and cheap. Most of all, Ruhi is very helpful and reactive. He will help you and indicate you where to find the best spot in Istanbul. I really enjoyed my stay in his flat, and I know where to go next time I go to Istanbul. If you are looking for the perfect spot to enjoy this vibrant city, don't look any further!

I had an amazing time during my stay in Istanbul thanks to this wonderful Airbnb experience. The accommodation was not only comfortable and clean but also located in a fantastic area, making it easy to explore the beautiful surroundings. The host's hospitality and local tips were invaluable in making my trip memorable. I highly recommend this Airbnb and look forward to returning in the future!

description: The room is a 5-minute walk from Istiklal Street and is located on a quiet and ideal street to stay. Our apartment is within walking distance to Istiklal Street, Taksim and Galatasaray Square and Galata Tower. It is very close to all cafes, pubs, historical places and also very close to bus and metro stops. There are supermarkets within 1 minute. The room is cleaned periodically. We look forward to welcoming you in the historical atmosphere of Beyoğlu :)

reviews.text: Good stay, Omer was very flexible with check in/out times which was a great help. Communication was ok, took a while to get back to me when I arrived. No phone number provided. Bathroom was small as pictured. Nice big bedroom, firm mattress, he changed the sheets fresh when I arrived. 3rd floor, no lift in an older building but he helped with my bags. You might have to walk to the main street to get a cab. 15 minutes walk to Taksim Square.

I really enjoyed my stay at this Airbnb. Ömer is extremely friendly and makes you feel welcome. The Airbnb is clean and has a great location. Further the wifi is good. The best part of staying at the place was meeting some new people from all around the world.
Ömer and his friend are very nice people for sure. The neighborhood in which the apartment is located is pretty shady though and the apartment itself was not clean enough to feel fully comfortable.
There was a clean and comfortable atmosphere. the host was also very kind. I hosted very nicely
Omer was very communicative and a friendly host, the apartment was clean and had everything. good location. would definitely stay there again

description:
A Comfortable Escape in the Heart of History

We are located in the heart of Old Istanbul, from Sultanahmet and Hagia Sophia (5 minutes), the Grand Bazaar (7 minutes walking). With easy access to public transportation, you can reach all parts of Istanbul.
Your comfortable room is entirely yours. Bathrooms, kitchens, and other are shared.

All your bathroom needs, including towels, shampoo, bathrobes, and disposable slippers, are provided by us.

reviews.text:
We thank the host Mustafa very much for offer us such a nice stay in this beautiful city. This place is very nice and comfortable to stay. The location is perfect as it is close to all the attractions. The room is very clean，including the bathroom. The refrigerstor is well organised with a bottle of free drinking water. There is also a very clean and wide topfloor where many exercise facilities are provided. I guess that is I guess that's why Mustafa has a good figure. He kindly helped us carry our luggage to the up room because we had a little too much luggage. He also give us sincere suggestions about our trip around the city. And most importantly，I think the price is also very to us as it is high cost-effectiveness. In short，we enjoy our stay here and we definitely think we will stay here again in the future. Thank you Mustafa.
I nearly forget to mention that I also very comfortable that the hosts are always promptly reply to my questions and proactively give me such details.

Your search for an Airbnb in Istanbul is over because Social House is easily one of the BEST Airbnb I’ve stayed at EVER!
Pros
Location: you cannot find a better location! A few minutes walk from Hagia Sophia, blue mosque, tram, Hafiz Mustafa (trust you’d want to visit the dessert shop), grand bazaar and everything you’d want to see in Istanbul.
Host: Absolutely wonderful hosts available 24/7. They allowed us to check-in late, was extremely responsive, gave great directions and guides, and even helped us book an early morning taxi at 5am. They were all very friendly, spoke great English and made sure that we felt right at home :)
Common area: they have an iMac and printer for use, a large tv with PS4 (had a great night playing fifa), fresh tea and coffee, workspaces, and overall great vibes ✨ we met some really wonderful people here and had some fun chatting and hanging out ❤️
Highly recommend social house because you not only get a comfortable place to stay, at a great location at an incredible value - but you might also make some new friends too.

Check in was great. The hosts reached out asking when I’d be coming and if I needed an airport taxi. They have 24/7 concierge so they were able to meet us in person at 6am for a check in. Bathrooms are shared but cleaned daily by a cleaning staff. Common room was comfortable and usable. Free coffee and tea is a bonus. And filtered tap in the kitchen for drinking water. Location is phenomenal too. Would stay again

Mustafa is THE BEST HOST. We spent a couple of days at Social House, then traveled a few days outside Istanbul, then back to Istanbul- but at a different Airbnb (Social House was not available on our specific dates). When we returned to the city, we felt comfortable and welcomed to text Mustafa with questions, even though we were not staying at his hostel. Having a trustworthy local guide available, to give honest suggestions about their city is a gift from the travel gods. Thank you Mustafa, you are great at what you do and have made a positive impact on our travels in Turkey.
The Social House is clean and tidy, including the kitchen and the bathrooms. All other guests were respectful. There is designated space in a refrigerator for each room, and the common areas are a perfect size to feel cozy in. Social House openly welcomes you to message them if there is anything at all that you need, i.e. directions, if bathroom needs attention, or if you need something specific within or outside the hostel. Very friendly staff. We enjoyed our stay here very much and will stay here again in the future. :)

This is a very good location to explore the sultanahmet area. I was surprised at how walkable everything is here once you arrive.
The room was clean and the bed was comfortable.
I’m always a little worried about checking into accommodations with shared restrooms but the floor had 2 men’s toilets and 2 showers - all in individual rooms as well as a separate bathroom for women. It was very convenient.
The shared common area was nice and cozy with 2 workstations if you want to lock in on your work.
At this price range I would say this is one of the gems in this area.

description: This is a studio wiit private bathroom center of the Kadıköy. We have same or similar room too much. We have reception 24/7. Wi fi, wash machine, free tea and coffe and cameras all corridor. And very comfort bed and clean sheets and towels.

reviews.text: If you are looking for a cheap accommodation in Kadiköy then this is a great option. The location is very convenient. The bed was comfortable. Some cosmetic fixes could be done in the bathroom, but we didn’t really mind it due to the low price. If you are a light sleeper you may want to get a room further away from the elevator, which is a bit loud.

A great value for the money. The space is decent, quiet and the bed is comfortable. The toilet needs a lot to improve on but at least the hot water is working. It is very near to the bus/metro and main business areas. Over all a very nice place to stay.
We enjoyed our stay. the location is great, and we felt the value for money spent was high. Friendly and helpful staff. Cleanliness was a little lacking, with some mold in the bathroom.

The room wasn’t exactly like on the picture. Also it said room with a balcony, but the balcony wasn’t there. When we entered the room straight away felt the smell of cigarettes, it felt like someone just left this room, bedding didn’t feel clean, there was a stranger stain. Bathroom also didn’t feel clean enough. I left the room after one night.
Perfect location with reasonable price. Would recommend to couples who look for a safe and clean place at such central location for short term. Mr Yasin takes care of everything perfectly.

description:
Stay in a stylish one bedroom apartment. Recently renovated with all the historical featured and all the modern amenities.
Full oven, central heating, washer/drying machine with full kithcen utilities.
Double bedroom and a stylish open lounge with double sofa bed.

reviews.text: Joan’s place is very well equipped and is exactly like the photos. It is good for one or two people. I had everything I needed for a comfortable stay for a week. The kitchen, WiFi, washing machine and hot water (shower) are excellent. It is a street-level apartment. There is a lot of foot traffic because this street is one of the most popular for taking photos, due to the colorful buildings. If you go down the hill (towards the water), there are many cafes and restaurants and it is generally quite crowded. There are many walking tours, this area was historically Greek and Jewish and there is a lot to see. If you go up the hill from the apartment, you will find the commercial area, which has a conservative religious vibe. You will see a huge variety of Islamic dress. The apartment is a short walk to the bus, which makes it easy to go to other areas in the city.

A beautiful little gem in Istanbul, Fatih, Badal. It was an absolute pleasure spending my time there. It is perfect for short & long stays.
The little apartment is well equipped with modern and new stuff. Everything you need for kitchen (I'm a cook, and I loved it), an amazing washing machine, that for me means so much! Overall very good quality.
The apartment is small, so fits well for couples, groups of 3 or 4. They have a sofa also that probably can be made into a bed. It's on the basement floor (probably an ex basement made into a small flat, which is an amazing way to preserve the place). Windows are protected by steel, so it is absolutely safe.
It is located on one of the European parts. A nice, quiet, safe, and local neighbourhood. It is a European side that feels a lot more Asian or Middle East. Istanbul is big, so you need to get around by public transport. The apartment is nicely located not far from buses where you can take connections. There are very nice places for speciality coffee, good breakfast and amazing lunch.
The hosts were not there so didn't have a chance to meet them, however there are people who will welcome you and will be there for help if needed. The communication with the hosts and local hosts was clear and understanding. They also give tips for spending the best time in Istanbul.
I highly recommend this place for stays in Istanbul.

Quaint street level place that is close to grocery, metro and attractions. Host is responsive. Enjoyed My stay. AC was re-charged during my 2 month stay as it gets very hot inside. Has everything you need for a longer stay and would recommend. All positive just note a few things: 1) no shower curtain and wood molding does have some mold only in shower area 2) take trash to bins, no street pickup but bins are close by 3) this is a heavily visited street for tourists so lots of foot traffic about during the day.

It's a very cozy basement unit with wonderful interior, very comfortable to stay in. There is everything you need for a long stay. The heating works good and there was no problem with water or anything. The hosts are very friendly and responding to all the questions. It's a very good apartment in a very nice neighbourhood on that very street with the famous coloured houses just next to your door. I would choose to stay there again in future!

✅ Good location
✅ Kind Host
✅ Good kitchen and equipment of the flat
✅ Nice restaurants around
➖ It is very difficult to ventilate the room; ➖there are a large number of small insects. the day began with the destruction of them, ➖ small toilet with a small sink in which it was impossible to wash without dousing yourself with water.
The apartment is good, but requires some minor improvements to get 5 stars, so far it’s a solid 4. I can recommend the apartment ❤️
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Sultanahmet Apart & Suites: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Sultanahmet is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, our mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text:
The accommodation is a bit smaller than it seems at first glance, but this compromise is excellent value for money - the main attractions are a 5-8 minute walk from the accommodation. If you are only interested in cultural values ​​and attractions, it is worth booking here, - the restaurants and shops are of course priced for tourists, but if you are willing to walk a little more, you can find more local restaurants. The tram is about an 8 minute walk from the accommodation and one of the most important transport lines, the marmaray, is about a similar distance. For about 100+ liras, it passes through the entire city. - Taxis are worth avoiding :)
The host is really fair and so are his workers. Messages are almost always answered within about 1 hour. 0-24 convenience stores are 150m from the accommodation.
(The staircase of the accommodation is decorated with the host's beautiful photos of Turkey, which are worth looking at - at least it gave us the desire to go on trips:)

Happy to find Ercan's apartment. Feel so comfortable like at home and safe.
Mr. Yunus Sayim, is a great host. Attentive, communicative, friendly and always reachable.
The staff are friendly. The rooms are exactly same as shown at the pictures.
Location is good, only few minutes walking distance, I reached Hagia Sophia, Blue mosque, Sultan Ahmet Park.
Room is clean, bed is very comfortable
Restaurants and cafes are around and there is a small supermarket nearby for the daily needs.
I find the rate is reasonable for the service provided.
I will recommend Duru apartment and suite to the next visitors in Istanbul and for sure will stay here again for my next trip to Istanbul :-)

We had a wonderful stay here. The apartment was exceptionally clean, hygienic, and very well maintained, which made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. The staff was incredibly helpful, always available online, and responded quickly whenever we needed anything. Their hospitality made us feel truly welcomed, like valued guests rather than just visitors.
The location is perfect — everything is within walking distance, only 2–5 minutes away. There are many great restaurants nearby, including several lovely rooftop restaurants around the area, which made our stay even more enjoyable.
Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for comfort, convenience, and warm hospitality

I stayed at the Duru Sultanahmet apartment in the historical heart of Istanbul, and it was absolutely perfect. The space is exactly as shown in the pictures — clean, comfortable, and full of charm. The location couldn’t be better, just steps away from all the major historical sites, from mosques to museums, with great shops, restaurants, and the Sea of Marmara nearby for stunning sunrises and sunsets.
Kabir, the apartment manager, was friendly, helpful, and always available to make things easier. Yunus, the apartment partner, took care of everything — from arranging my airport pickup to offering great recommendations for dining, shopping, and even spa services. No request was ever too big or too small.
I arrived at Istanbul Airport at 5:00 AM, and Yunus had already arranged a driver to pick me up. Kadir went the extra mile to make sure I could check in early at 2:00 PM, which I truly appreciated.
Everything about this stay was exceptional — I’ll definitely be coming back soon!

Really loved this place! I can only speak for the room I stayed in (I got an upgrade) but I think they speaks to the host overall. The room felt like a nice hotel room for an incredible price!
I enjoyed the black out curtains, kitchenette, private bath/shower and large bed! It was clean, well designed and truly was a great value.
The area of town was incredibly close to restaurants and attractions for those visiting for the first time. Truly where you want to stay when visiting Istanbul!

description:
Welcome to Çukurcuma!
Right next to Innocence Museum, This charming apartment is located on the second floor of a historic three-story building in Çukurcuma, one of Istanbul’s most atmospheric and culturally rich neighborhoods.

reviews.text:
Host is nice, apt is located close to amenities. keep in mind streets are very steep /inclined in the area. The apt is on a 3rd floor without elevator and very narrow stairs.
A big downside for me was the construction noise/ dust next door and the broken mattress- I slept on a 45 degree angle and left with back pain. Mosque is close by and you can hear loudly the call to prayer 4x day.
I kindly suggest the host to provide a better experience by providing transparency in the description, soft towels, better bed covers (place was very cold) and minimum convenience items in the kitchen. Kitchen and bathroom are very, very small. I’m petite and struggled to move around.
Host is nice, response time and assistance can be much better.

This place has a rustic charm and is very conveniently located, with many cafe’s and shops nearby and is just a 5 minute walk from the train station. And Busra is a lovely host who went out of her way to make our stay as comfortable as possible. The only drawbacks are that it can get a bit hot if your visit is during the summer and the neighbors can be a bit loud at night. But Busra was kind enough to bring us standing fans to alleviate the heat and also even tried to relocate us to another property she manages that had central air conditioning, which we really appreciated. But the place grew on us and we ended up having a lovely time.

The location and architecture of the apartment were absolutely wonderful. All the furniture and appliances were brand new, and the kitchen was very well-equipped and functional. The bed was super comfortable, and the entire place — including the sheets — was spotless. The bathroom was also very practical and perfectly clean. I was really satisfied with my stay. If I come back to Istanbul, this is definitely a place I’d love to stay again. Thank you for everything!

I had a wonderful stay at Busra’s place in Istanbul. The apartment was clean, cozy, and comfortable, and the location was very convenient. Busra was also very kind, helpful, and easy to communicate with. I really enjoyed my stay and would definitely recommend her place! 😊

Busra's place is absolutely stunnig: best Istanbul district but calm street, comfortable and cosy interior, a lot of space, all furniture, home textile and kitchenware you need. Busra is very helpful and kind.
It's could be tricky to stay in flat with toddler because of stairs and no central heating but its not a problem of flat or Busra at all! for couples and a little older kids it should be perfect!

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Appartment was not cleaned before we arrived. And there was some problem of humidity in one of the bedroom. The place is not too far from beaches. It is near a mosque. Other than that it was spacious and well decorated with a nice balconee.
it's a small comfortable place in a rustic area. We enjoyed our stay.

House has instant booking option but host doesn't know that. After be booked and paid we heads up to the place and host told us place is occupied cuouple more days and said "we should call him" before we book, instead blockin unavailable dates. We had long conversation and he never said even "sorry" instead he blamed us. He also told us verbally check-in is 12pm and check-out is 12pm next day. So it was 5pm same day when we booked so it supposed be ready 5 hours before we arrive but he was thinking we are 5 hours late. But place still was occupied 5 days. He received money and never cancelled and didn't refunded us. He said if im not happy I can cancel but not him. I was needing to spend 2-3 hours to comunicate Airbnb support to get refund. Totally disaster, if you don't wanna mess up your vacation stay away this place.
the place was nice and clean, the only thing missing was the duvet covers. But i can recommend this apartment.
谷歌地图指引的是错的，电话打不通，信息回复很慢。没有房子指引图，洗衣机漏水。洗澡水一会凉一会热。没有空调。没有WiFi.糟糕的一天。

description:
The house is in the center of Teşvikiye. It is 15 min to Osmanbey Metro, 10 min to Beşiktaş Çarşı, 10 min to City's Mall.

There are lots of classy and cosy cafes and bars nearby. The house is very close to shopping and fashion district of Istanbul. Maçka Park is 10 mins away which is the biggest park in the central area. There is a grocery and liquor stores nearby, upon until late night.

The guests will share the house with me. Also, the kitchen is fully equipped. Suitable for remote work.

reviews.text: Hazal is a kind, thoughtful, friendly and trustworthy person. She is one of the best hosts I’ve met so far. The location of the house is very good - lots of things to do around it. The flat was very clean and the room is large and comfortable. Internet was fast so I could work online well. All in all I had a great home stay experience in a nice, safe and central place. Highly recommended 🙂

Hazal is a very thoughtful host, her place is very clean and stylish. Room is very comfortable and location is great, has everything you may need walking distance. Perfect for a short stay of 1-2 people exploring Istanbul.

The apartment has a perfect location between Nişantaşi and Beşiktaş and the neighborhood of Teşvikiye itself offers many nice cafes, streets and shops. Even later in the evening I never had any problems to find a transportation home.
The room is spacious and welcoming and I slept there very well, even with an open window. The bed is huge and super comfortable.
Communication with Hazal was very easy and she welcomed me in person. She is so friendly. Would definitely stay again

Hazal’s apartment with lovely decor and spotlessly clean.It was ideally located on the High Street, literally a few steps always from several restaurants and shops, plus several tourist attractions. I could not have asked for a better location. ( 5min from bus stations, 12 min from Osmanbey metro station)
Hazal was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to my needs/requests. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful.
Overall a wonderful place , would definitely stay again.

Its a quaint apartment in the middle of one of the busiest and most expensive neighborhoods in Istanbul. Its very clean and close to all the "it" places of the city center. Ideal for exploring on foot or with a short bus or train ride.

description: This spacious and stylish accommodation is suitable for all groups wishing to enjoy all the delights of Istanbul

reviews.text: We had a very comfortable 17-day stay at Fuad’s place. His apartment is quite luxurious and only couple of steps away from a shopping mall. The venue is located in Atasehir and was convenient for driving to main attractions of Istanbul. Mr Fuad is a great host, he answered all of our questions timely and was very helpful.

Everything is perfect.
Location, facilities, air-conditioning, kitchen, views etc. all I expected. Better than 5 star hotel.

Great apartment, very clean, very well situated and provides a beautiful sweeping view of this great city. the host Fuad is always available and takes good care of the guests. Great stay at the apartment and an ideal place to be in for long stays. great experience overall.
Faud is a great host, everything was perfect thanks to him, place is amazing, perfect location I couldn't ask for better

If you want to stay in style and really enjoy an accommodation. Stay at this spot. It's spotless and has everything you need to feel at home and the view is fantastic. Awesome host, staff and even building management was accommodating. Everything you need is on premise so you really don't need a car if you are just having a relaxing week. 5+ Stars. Would love to stay again soon!

description:
This beautiful historical newly luxury furnished 2-bedroom apartment it is located in of the most picturesque streets of Beyoglu.
Just 2 minutes walking distance to all these attractions:
- Bophorus
- Galataport (newly opened venue by the seaside)
- Istanbul Modern Museum
- Galata Tower
- Istiklal Street - the main pedestrian street which is the most attractive street of the city

Metro and tram stations are both 250 meters (800 feet) far. (Please see the attached map)

reviews.text: It's a well-located apartment near both the tram and tube lines. The space is quite small especially the kitchen and one of the bedrooms, but was absolutely fine for three people. The shower room is very nice and the shower is great. The kitchen is not brilliantly well-equipped if you want to self-cater, and there is only room for three people to sit at the table. Communication was great - helpful and very fast, both with the owner and his nephew who let us into the apartment. The hallway of the apartment block is a bit dingy / dirty and the electrics throughout the building don't look altogether safe, but I suspect that's common throughout the city. Overall, a fair price for the apartment and we had a good stay.

Great price for family trip and very convenient location. It's only 5mins walk to galata Tower and 5mins walk to metro, shopping center area and tunnel. Can is very friendly and great communication, we had a late flight on arrival , his nathew was so lovely and wait for us next to the metro. Besides of near main eat out area , I will recommend just go downstairs of the apartment to try the local pida and donner restaurant. More authentic flavour and good price.Can's apartment is clean and very stylish. Everything you need is inside and there are few convenient shops downstairs.

Can’s place is an absolute gem. Great location, close to everything yet peaceful, safe and quiet. Very clean, comfortable and cozy. Well equipped. It got cold in December and the heating worked very well. Lots of hot water and great water pressure. Small convenience stores a few steps away (literally) where you can get all the basics for breakfast and snacks.
Can’s nephew helped us with check-in. Very friendly and responsive.
I would definitely return to this cozy and lovely apartment.
Thanks Can and Ertunc!

This was one of the most beautiful airbnbs I’ve ever stayed at - exactly like the pictures, WONDERFULLY located - near the action but on a quiet street, very easy to find, very easy to get around. Can’s nephew helped us check in and was very friendly and helpful with local recommendations. The flat is beautiful and felt like home - we didn’t want to leave. The bathroom was clean, well equipped with toiletries, and the kitchen had everything we needed and more. If I ever return to Istanbul, I will rebook without a second thought.

Can's place was clean, comfortable, and it had everything we needed. The communication was easy and quick. The apartment is also located very centrally, right in the middle of all the fun and touristy things in Beyoglu. The host was flexible and helped us with any requests or issues we had immediately. We did stay shorter than we had planned mostly because we were traveling with elderly parents and the stairs to the apartment were pretty narrow.

description: This is an apartment with a magnificent view on the second floor of a 140-year-old historical building. It has two bedrooms and a room with a balcony, one of which is very large. You can cook your meals in the kitchen. It is between Beyoğlu and Şişhane. Transportation is very easy. Bus stops 1 minute away, metro 9 minutes away.

reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at Fatih's place. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described and depicted in the photos. It was a quick walk away from Istiqlal St. and many other attractions. Even though the place is on a busy boulevard, we had no issue with noise at night. The beds were very comfy and the AC worked perfectly. The wi-fi was a little unstable and slow but was not much of an issue at all. The kitchenette has enough appliances and supplies for four people, including a coffee maker, turkish coffee pot and electric kettle. There is no elevator so you do have to carry your luggage up the stairs but the stairs are not steep and the staircase is pretty wide. Fatih was super nice and responsive and accommodated all our requests. Overall, I highly recommend the place for a stay in Istanbul!

When we arrived the power was out. The host didn't tell us this ahead of time, but met us outside the building. He seemed flustered by the power situation. There were candles in the stairwell to find our way upstairs, then we had to use cellphone flashlights in the flat. Could not charge devices and no wifi. Power was restored sometime after noon the next day. When power came back the wifi didn't really work for me, it was super slow so I just used data the whole time. The room was pretty. Nicely decorated. The host was responsive. I liked the location for proximity to food, although seemed sketchy when we first arrived, better once we understood the area. Of the two bedrooms, one did not have a door, and the other one had a door that could not latch. Bathroom/shower/shampoos etc were all nice. Could hear the people in the room above me, each step and as they were talking. Host said it is because it is a heritage building, but he did message the neighbour to keep it down after midnight

The best part of this listing was my interaction with the host. He is a true gentleman and offered excellent communication. He also agreed to a late check-out which showed a great deal of consideration and flexibility. He was always pleasant to interact with.
The two-bedroom apartment is cozy, clean and well decorated.
With that said, there are a few drawbacks to this apartment. The apartment is in a house that is over 100 years old. You hear all the creaks and rumblings of the other guests in their rooms. Moreover, the house is located right off a major highway. It is extremely loud and noisy 24/7. This makes it very difficult to sleep.
Another drawback is the WIFI connection and speed. The WIFI connection was very weak and would drop frequently. There needs to be a network directly in the room, instead of a few networks throughout the house. The host did his best in resolving this problem; however, I was not able to make video calls for work over the course of the week. The signal was simply not strong enough. This was a huge problem for me as I work remotely. I ended up having to open up a hotspot with my cellular data for the entire week to get work done. Streaming any kind of videos (e.g. Youtube, Netflix) was not possible.

The house was very warm and cosy exactly what we needed after a walk in the cold, there was hot water in the shower, fatih provided towels,shampoo,tea,coffee and all the necessaries, fatih was very friendly and helpful he helped with carrying the bags and recommended places to go since it was out first time visit, i would definitely stay here again 10/10

The place was good and as described - not 5 star but what was expected. The rooms were a good size with a king size bed in each room. Kitchen was small but ok for making Teas and coffees. Bathroom was small but functional, shower was hot with reasonable water pressure. No TV which was OK as we spent most of the time out.
Location was handy as a short walk to the bar area and just past that to Istiklal street.
Metro was easy to reach, turn left and over the road to Taksim or turn right and over the road to Shishane - definitely get an Istanbul card for travelling! Overall as expected with no problems, thanks Fatih!

description: Featuring a fully equipped kitchen, this room is ideal for long stays. A comfortable room combining modern and traditional style. The room is in the basement but the room has a total of five windows. The sun shines throughout the room, it is not dark, it is pleasant and it is in the center of Taksim. Taksim and Şişhane metro is 10 minutes away, and there is a bus stop 50 meters from the building. All eating and drinking areas are very close.

reviews.text:
This was my first time in Istanbul, and Fatih Bey’s hospitality made this city feel as it was very familiar.
The studio was clean and with everything that you might need( hot water, very useful kitchen, clean towels and bedsheet and a comfy bed).
Fatih Bey, was always rapidly reactive to my messages and very comprehensive on my last day when I had to leave my luggage for a long time.
And when it comes to the location, you get to have a taste of taksim life without the noise, since taksim square is just a few minutes walk.
The accommodations are easily accessible.
Bus stations, metro, pharmacies, and shops are all very near.
This stay was very special to me.
Thank you!

We were welcomed by Fatih‘s brother, we had everything we needed for a nice few days exploring Istanbul. The location was good, just a short walk to busy areas with bars and restaurants. The bed was comfortable and the room clean, overall great value

Fatih was a friendly and nice host. Helped us with any issues we had. The place was also nice, just right as at the pictures, it was clean and had all the equipment for a long stay. The bed was comfortable. Wifi is very good for remote work. But there were a lot of noise from the street and if you are a light sleeper you will struggle without earplugs.

Fatih very friendly and nice host and he always trying to create comfort.
The place not good enough even for just sleep and if you planning spend more time in apartment this place not exactly good idea
It’s was our fault about we didn’t realize it’s real outside door in room just next from bed.
And it’s was our fault we not check this neighbour before and not check map cause this place near with highway, sometimes it’s feeling you sleeping at the road.
But apartment was really clean inside, but it strong smells cats outside, maybe it’s nice option for save money but comfort more important.
And i have situation about i lost my phone and i clearly remember i was especially charged this phone before we leaving flat, im not blame anyone but late my phone was turn on in locator app in Istanbul…
police refused to accept the application, and the host did not even offer to watch the CCTV footage
so this situation more spoiled all experience about trip, this flat and city.

Fatih and his Brother Eser welcomed us warmly, were always available and extremely friendly. Eser cooked a typical turkish dinner & breakfast for us, gave us many recommendations and was always here when we needed help. The little apartement is perfectly clean, has a great size for two people and is like shown in the photos. It is in the basement and therefore pretty dark but that‘s also written in the description and the price is very good! We would definitely come back.

description: Located at Besiktas/Abbasağa next to Abbasağa park very centrally, Bosporus, Usküdar and Sultanahmet area. Easy access to all main transport facilities like bus, metro-bus, metro and in-city ferry lines on routine schedules. 5 min. walking distance to Besiktas center offering a livelihood venue with coffeshops , bars and shopping alternatives.

reviews.text:
We really enjoyed our stay in this nice, bright apartment in Beşiktaş. It was clean and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The Wi-Fi speed and water pressure were good. You can easily walk to the more lively areas in the neighborhood where there are bars and restaurants, but the apartment’s street is really quiet, so you won’t have trouble resting at night. The apartment is on the second floor of a building without an elevator and the street is steep: I was already familiar with the area and it was not a problem for us, but consider it if you have mobility problems.
Tolga is a good host; he was very friendly and helpful. You will have no problem contacting him if you need help during your trip. I would definitely like to return to Tolga’s apartment on my next stay in Istanbul.

The host was responsive and helpful, but unfortunately that was the only positive. On arrival, we found the place dusty, with mold in the coffee machine from beans left behind, and used soap bars left in the bathroom.
The neighborhood was the biggest issue. Getting anywhere meant climbing a lot of stairs, even just to reach the grocery store. We had a power outage from 12:30 pm until 3 am — locals told us the infrastructure in the area is old and outages are common. We also lost internet for almost half a day on another occasion.
It was also extremely noisy: a neighbor left their TV on all night, and cars and motorcycles came and went constantly, forcing us to keep the windows shut. There's no central AC, just one portable unit that only cooled one room, leaving the other unbearably hot.
Overall, not a place we'd recommend.

Tolga is a great host! Very friendly and with a great sense of humor. He was very helpful and let us check in earlier when we arrived. On the last day when we had to leave, He also let us leave our luggage so we could take a walk until it was departure time. There was coffee, tea, fresh water, beer and some snacks in the appartment. The place has everything you need. The beds are very comfortable and the place is quiet. There is a super market with everything you need just down stairs. A beautiful park and several places to eat just a few steps away. It is also close to a bus and metro station. The live part of Besiktas is also super close. Definitely recommend Tolga and His place. Will stay here when visiting next time for sure!

Very comfortable, private, central location. On the second floor of an apartment building at the corner of a steep hill, you will find everything you need at this location. There were clean towels, a functioning kitchen, cable TV, breezy rooms with many windows, and a sizeable bathroom. Engin is a lovely, chatty host who lives nearby and is always ready to help.

Engin is an excellent host and his flat provided a great base for us while we explored Istanbul for the first time. Besiktas is a very calm, laidback neighbourhood, close enough to the old town (30 mins by bus/ferry) but far enough to avoid its hassle, noise, and high prices. A lot of nice quirky cafes and restaurants around, easy to walk everywhere even at night. The flat was very clean and had everything we needed. It's an amazimg deal!

description: You can enjoy this beautiful brand new apartment near Şişli, with an excellent location, in a pleasant place and close to the city center, shops, hospitals. It has 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, washing machine, kitchen with basic appliances (fridge, stove, kettle and full kitchen utensils), dining room. Wi-Fi internet access and garage included.

reviews.text: Property is clean and check in was easy. Linen had stains on it but was easily replaced after some time. Shower corners had mould but it wasn’t too bad. Overall apartment is clean and comfortable. Price is slightly high for apartment.

There are a lot of ants in the apartment, and the bed sheets are not clean. Other than that, everything is excellent.
Car parking there also , safe place , near to the center.👍

It is a convenient place to stay at in Istanbul. 2 bedrooms, a living room and a kitchen. There are a waching machine and a dryer. There is an underground parking lot. Many stores in the nearby. 24/7 Security.

İsmail beyin evi merkezi konumda. Ev çok temiz ve modern. Eşyalar yeni. Girişte 7/24 güvenlik durmakta içiniz rahat olsun. Otoparkı mevcut. İsmail bey bütün sorularımıza hızlı ve net cevap verdi. Toplu taşımaya çok yakın. Gönül rahatlığı ile tercih edebilirsiniz. Biz çok memnun kaldık.

Oncelikle ev sahibi ile ilgili soyleme gereken sey su 10/7 olur cunku kiralamadan once hizli bir sekilde cevap veriyordu ama kiralama sonrasi gec cevap veriyorudu ikinci olarak kisi degisikligi yaptiktan sonra ekstra bir ucret talep etmedi ve anlayis gosterdi yalan yok .

Ev ile ilgili soyleyeceklerim fotografta gorundugu gibi buyuk degil tersine tavani alcak ve kucuk ve otoparki gercekten cok dar yani otoparka girdiginiz zaman butun arabalarin sag solu vurdugunu goruyorsunuz eger uzun arabaniz varsa hem sokakgi dar hem otopaki .
Ev gayet temizdi onunla ilgili bir problem yasamadik ve petekler calisiyordu ve ev sicakti
Ama evin konumu cok iyi degil acikcasi ve ev birinci katta ama genel olarak ben 10/6 veririm umarim bu verdigim bilgiler kiralamaniza yardimci olur

description:
24/7 Security, a New building with an elevator, brand new furniture, modern decoration,
Located in the heart of the city, Easy access to Taksim Square, Subway, and the surrounding attractions.
Living room with built-in kitchen and 1 bedroom,
Smart TV in Living Room and Bedroom
Refrigerator, Kettle, Air Conditioner, Combi Boiler, Safe Box
Dishwasher, Washing Machine, Microwave Oven, iron-ironing board
100 Mbps Fiber internet,
Towels-shampoo is available
Housekeeping is provided every 2 days.

reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 weeks. Nice stay, the apartment is like on the pictures. For such long stays, it missed some of the basic kitchen stuff, which was quickly provided by the host after asking for it. Service is awesome. Cleaning multiple times per week optional, we chose once a week. The area outside is quite dirty, but it is quite central and we could reach most interesting places of the city quite comfortably. Shuttle bus to and from airport is right at vicinity at Taksim square, which is awesome. In summary, we can recommend staying here :)

We enjoyed our stay. The apartment was warm, the towels were large and fresh, the bed and pillows were comfortable, the room was clean, and everything matched the photos. The view from the third floor was superb. The building's location is very convenient: many cafes and shops are nearby, and Taksim Square, the metro, and the main pedestrian street are just a 10-minute walk away. The staff deserves a special mention; rest assured, all your questions will be answered and resolved. Thank you for everything, and we will definitely see you again.

We had a great stay at this brand-new apartment in Istanbul. Everything was clean, modern, and well-maintained. The building and the apartment felt new and comfortable, with all the essentials needed for a pleasant stay.
The location was convenient, with easy access to transportation, shops, and restaurants. The host was very responsive, helpful, and made the check-in process smooth and easy.
Overall, a perfect choice for anyone visiting Istanbul. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place.

+
The flat is very bright, we enjoyed the beautiful view.
It’s very central and practical to move around the city and full of shops and supermarkets around. The cleaning service and taxi transfer are much appreciated too.
Onur and Ismail are great hosts.
-
However I recommend to close all windows since the call to prayer is extremely loud (the first one is around 5.45AM) but that’s part of the Istanbul experience. The neighbors were loud and we could hear them at night from the bedroom since the walls are pretty thin. We love cooking and it would have been nice to have more cooking basics and maybe olive oils salt and pepper too even though Ismail was very reactive and brought us almost everything we needed upon request feee of charge. Another negative point is the neighborhood in general, you want to avoid walking on the main road down the hill since that part is unsafe. Always walk up the hill.

I had booked this place for my parents’ 35-night stay during their visit to Istanbul. Onur was very helpful throughout the booking process — he answered all my questions and addressed any concerns I had about their arrival and check-in.
Ismail was especially wonderful throughout their stay. He checked on them regularly, provided anything they needed, and was always very quick to respond. He truly made them feel at home, and it gave me great peace of mind knowing there was someone they could rely on whenever they needed help.
The apartment is located on a very steep street, but once you get past that, it’s only minutes away from Taksim, with plenty of shopping and restaurants nearby.
Overall, it was a great stay for my parents, and a very special thanks to Ismail for making their visit so much more comfortable and enjoyable.

description: It's the best place to relax and enjoy your stay. Cozy, stylish, naturally lighted apartment on the 16th floor with a big balcony where you can relax and enjoy your stay while looking at the amazing city of Istanbul and the big lake.

reviews.text: The place was clean and modern. Parking was abundant and there is 24/7 front desk staff. Please note - the address in the airbnb app took us to the WRONG location in another city 20 mins away with the same address! Use the pin that the host texts you instead. We had a few issues during our stay and our host was very quick to respond and correct the issue. He also gave us local recommendations that were helpful. Note: there is no microwave! Bring your own cooking oil, salt, etc. if you plan to use the kitchen.

Ev sahibimiz ilk rezervasyonumuzdan itibaren ilgiliydi. Eve girmeden önce sorularımıza cevap verdi. İstanbula varış saatimiz çok ters bir vakit olmasına ve rezervasyon saatinden önce olmasına rağmen eve girmemiz icin gerekli koordinasyonu yaptı. Daire olması gerektiği gibi hazırdı. İlk günlerde fırınla ilgili ufak bir problem yaşadığımızda ev sahibimiz hemen gelip gerekeni yaptı. Kaldığımız katın tamamı ev sahibine ait olduğu için kendimizi daha rahat hissettik. Aracımız için açık otoparkta yerimiz vardı. Güvenlik ve bina hizmetlerinde bir eksiklik yoktu. Alışveriş yerleri yakın olduğu için arabasız bu islerimizi de hallettik. Binanın yakınında okul olduğu icin okul giriş çıkış saatlerinde bir miktar trafik olabiliyor. Özetleyecek olursak ev sahibimiz profesyonel bir şekilde bu işi yönetiyor. Gönül rahatlığıyla kalınabilir.

Easily one of the best AirBnb appartements I ever stayed in. Great in every way: fantastic location, ultra clean (even the hallway, one of the prettiest I've seen by the way), 24/7 concierge downstairs who was always friendly... the list goes on. Khaled, our host, made you feel like a VIP.

ilk defa Airbnb kullanıcısıyım. Doğal olarak bir sorunla karşılaşırmıyım dediğim oldu kendime.Ama gerekli aşamaları bitirdikten sonra,zaten ev sahibi direk sizle iletişim kuruyor veya sizde iletişim kurabiliyorsunuz.kafanızdaki soru işaretlerine büyük bir ölçüde gidiyor.iletişimi yani sizle diyalogu çok iyi bir ölçüde ev sahibi ile tanisiyorsunuz.evet ev sahibi gerçekten çok ilgili,hoşgörülü mütevazı bir insan..ihtiyaçlarınıza karşı çözüm amaçlı fazlasıyla yanınızda oluyor...daire çok temiz bir daire idi.Mobilyalar yeni ve temizdi,kanepeler, yatak,gayet rahat ve konforluydu.mutfakta,ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz bütün malzemeler var.bütün bunların yanında daire müthiş manzaralı geniş bir balkona sahip..ayrıca bina 7/24 Güvenlikli,binanın altında büyük bir süper market.genel olarak herşey fazlasıyla harikaydı..ev sahibine tekrar teşekkürlerimi iletiyorum.cok ilgili ve göstermiş olduğu Misafirperverliği için.Tekrar seyahatim de geleceğim adresim artık burası...

I’ve stayed at this Airbnb for the third time now, and it never disappoints. The place is always spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host is incredibly welcoming and attentive, making every stay smooth and enjoyable. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and relaxing place to stay I’ll definitely be coming back again!

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: staying at this airbnb made my trip 10x better. it was an experience as a whole, from the beautiful interior to the amazing vibe. i felt at home, Sasha and Onur were very welcoming and helpful, great communication! the room and toilet were very clean and i felt extremely comfortable throughout my stay. all the essentials were provided in addition to snacks and water. i was able to leave my luggage before and after check in/out. the neighborhood is beautiful, quiet and full of art and cafes. strong wifi at all times, which was helpful considering i’m a student. around 10 min walk to taksim square. totally recommend it <3

We really enjoyed our stay at Sasha's place. The art studio has a great vibe and it feels good to be there. The room is comfortable and has everything you need and there is a big common area where you can hang out. The room, bathroom and toilet were all very clean when we arrived. The apartment is in a great neighborhood in Istanbul, with many things to do and everything is within walking distance. Sasha and Onur were great hosts and helped us with everything we needed during our stay. We had a late arrival from the airport and they arranged an airport transfer and were there to great us personally. Also they gave us great tips for what to do around the city, which led us to the best Baklava in Istanbul. All in all we are really happy with our stay :)

Sasha and Onur were absolutely one of the nicest Airbnb hosts I’ve ever stayed with!
The location is wonderful, extremely friendly, hipster vibes, quite, 5-10 mins walk from anywhere within Cihangir, 12 mins walk to Galata Port, 10-15 mins walk to Galata and Taksim!
I will definitely go back again and again and recommend to everyone I know.
Sasha was extremely responsive, gave very helpful advices and guidance with the local areas and coffeeshops!
Immediate response to any inquiries including when I needed a heater and got it same day!
The kitchen is very well equipped and full of whatever you might need to snack, prepare a quick bite even cook a whole meal.
Wonderful attention to details like the linen sheets smelling heavenly, wonderful candles all around for you to burn and coze up!
Also ensured to introduce me to whoever was arriving in and out of the Airbnb who were very friendly people of a similar vibe!
Overall super chill and friendly and a ton to do always!

Sasha and Onur were both really sweet hosts. I had some flight complications but they worked closely with me to be there when I check in. Place was very clean.
Only note I would like to make is that there is only a fan in the room. I went during September so I was able to sleep without any issues. Keep that in mind if you are traveling for the really hot months.
The bathroom and everything was kept really clean. Great location. If you just walk down hill you can get to the bridge easily.

Such a unique place to stay in a great location! Rana and Rob are very accommodating hosts they are both artists and you can find some interesting art pieces at display. The place in general feels artsy, cosy and authentic, you can even buy local artworks/clothings here.
Besides that, in 1 minute walk from this place you have all the antique shops and galleries, 10 minutes walking you are in Istiklal and in 5 minutes you have the tram station to access all the historical sites. Unlike many places in Istanbul, you don't have to climb stairs or hills to reach this place.
I would definitely come back and suggest this place to anyone looking for a stay in the heart of Istanbul.

reviews.text: Very warm and welcoming hosts. Clean and comfortable place to stay during a long layover or any kind of visit in this beautiful city and country. The bed was comfortable, shower had amazing pressure and very hot temperature as described. WiFi throughout the entire building. Delicious Turkish breakfast. Make sure to bring a converter if you need to charge US devices. If you forget it’s ok because there’s a store near by.

The neighborhood was beautiful and the best attractions of Istanbul were merely a 5-minute walk. For someone who's traveling alone or even with a group friends, my suggestion is to stay at a place like for this cheap and spend the saved money on other things to experience. The beds were very clean and so were the bathrooms. Even though I arrived very late (around 2 AM), the host was there to receive me. They went beyond their responsibility and helped me secure a piece of luggage because I had forgotten it in hurry. This place is worth all your money and more! Definitely recommend :)

My friends and I stayed in the Female dorm at Antique hostel and it was perfect for our 3 night stay in Istanbul! The location is close to all of the major attractions, the included breakfast was amazing and rooftop views were incredible. Beds were typical uncomfortable hostel beds, but its what you expect for the price.

The place was organised, clean and well-located. The rooms are a bit too small that it looks in the pictures. The bunk bed was too low, I hit my head a couple times. Take towels with you, otherwise they will charge you extra money.
I'm glad I found this Hostel last minute. Location is just what I wanted and it is clean with nice personal. Very helpful and a really nice Hostel.

description:
This private house is very close to everything in Istanbul and makes it easy to plan your trip.
It is 5 minutes from Taksim Square in Istanbul, and if you wish, you can walk to the ferry pier in 7 minutes.
It is one of the most beautiful terraced houses in Cihangir.
It gets constant light and is very centrally located.
There are beautiful flowers, fruit trees and a large swing on the terrace.
It is very close to cafes, restaurants, cinemas, the harbor, shopping malls, clubs and museums.

reviews.text: Absolutely lovely flat in central çihangir location. Unique tile work, bright and airy, very large terrace. Fully stocked kitchen. Clean, bed comfortable. Host is a lovely human, incredibly kind and helpful, he assisted with a number of matters including accidentally locking myself out one morning. Very on top of his side and professional but chill and flexible with me on my end. Would stay here again in a heartbeat. Neighborhood is ideal, central to everything, access to everything (markets, nail and hair salon, pharmacy, tons of great and varied restaurants and coffee spots, pilates even) but not overwhelmingly chaotic or.

Wonderful stay in brilliant location and so worth the 75 stairs (and I have knee arthritis) to get that roof terrace and those views!!
Also really appreciated the water cooler.
Brief problem with the hot water one day but Pablo sent someone within half an hour to sort it.
I'd recommend this place to anyone.

Definitely the best location in istanbul. its 10 min walk to Taksim square and metro station. istiklal is right around the corner and cihangir is busting with authentic cafees, restourants and bars.
house was spotless clean, terrace was life changing, and having a barbecue while the sunset was priceless.
suitable for singles or couples with small kids.
Pablo was extremely helpful and easy to communicate.
Would definitely return.

Pablo's apartment is very well situated. Close to Taksim square and the neighborhood is very nice, good restaurants and cafés. And it is quiet at night.
Check in was very easy and a special thanks to Pablo for allowing an earlier check-in, this was appreciated.
However, the apartment needs a good cleaning, especially the kitchen. As for the terrace, there was some clutter so we didn't use it much.

Love the location and the terrace!
The flat is in an amazing location! Literally heart of Cihangir. The host was amazing, super easy check in and very flexible. The internet was great and the place was super clean. I will definitely stay there again when Im back!

description: Enjoy easy access to historical places, popular stores, and restaurants from this charming accommodation.

reviews.text:
Wonderful stay in Istanbul at Verseca Hotel
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Verseca Hotel in Istanbul and wanted to share my experience.
Positives:
The hotel was incredibly clean, with daily housekeeping, fresh linens, and towels.
Its location was very convenient, being just a short walk from the tramway station.
Plenty of shops, restaurants, and other amenities were nearby, making it easy to explore the city.
The hotel reception was highly responsive and helpful, even when contacted late at night.
They offered an affordable taxi reservation service to the airport, which was very convenient.
The staff went above and beyond to assist with planning our itinerary, even recommending rooftop terraces with stunning sea views.
Negatives :
My only regret was not choosing the sea view room, as I hesitated due to the slightly higher cost. However, after seeing the breathtaking view from the room,, I can confidently say it would have been worth the extra expense.

Great value for money! Located downhill from the Grand Bazzar and tram station - 5-10min walk. Beautiful views over the Sea of Marmara from the shared communal terrace. Please note, breakfast is available on the terrace for 200 TL pp. Room/bathroom are very clean and comfortable for a short stay. Please note, you’re booking a room in a hotel, our room was on the 4th floor and there is no elevator, but the receptionist kindly helped us carry our bags up. Would book again!

It has been a nice accomodation with all the utility described by the host, he was really helpful for all the information that we asked at any time.
Just one information for older people and who cannot do stairs and ascendent streets, in this case I wouldn't recommend it because it was really comfortable but without elevator and to reach the tram you need to walk a bit in a not so easy street.

This hotel was great. It has this beautiful rooftop terrace with a nice view over Istanbul. The room was clean, the cleaning personnel does their job. I had everything that I would need in a hotel room. The neighborhood is quiet at night time and a little busy and noisy in the daytime, but that is the spirit of Istanbul :) The location is close to Grand Bazar (10 mins walking) and other tourist spots like The Blue Mosque area (25 mins walking). Near the hotel, you can find a lot of small groceries stores.
Overall, it really makes more than the price you pay. I recommend!

Taxi could not access the road to drop off, and we had to haul suitcase uphill to get there. Neighborhood is sketchy. This place is the nicest on the street. Host came into our room and turned AC off, I told him we wanted it on. Later, he sent another gentleman to tell us to turn it off and to open the window if we were warm, then started sending messages through the app. Street is noisy and no screens on windows. The next day, when we went out, our "AC stopped working," he told us he could not look at it till after we left. We didn't sleep and would have moved locations if a cab could have picked us up out front.

description: Our house is centrally located, comfortable and has 24/7 security. The metrobus stop is 100 meters away. You can easily go to Taksim, Beyoğlu, Şişli, Beşiktaşa. The house has almost everything you may need. The house has a private balcony - as well as the site's shared city and sea view terraces. (On the 19th and 11th floors)

reviews.text:
Good located place, walking distance from marmaray station (public fast train), not so far (I was always walking) from the Kadikoy and thousands of cafes and restaurants. Couple of 24/7 local supermarkets located next to the building.
The place itself was warm (I was staying in the winter) and cozy (lots of different lights in different parts of apartments). I would recommend it for singles or couples as it has separate bedroom, relatively big kitchen with sitting area (TV included although I never used it), huge outside balcony with table and chairs.
Host itself was nice and quite proactive. Thanks Ж)

The house is very comfortable and clean, located in a nice area and close to the center of Kadikoy.
The host is very friendly and respectful.
I highly recommend the house and will rent it the next time i visit Istanbul for sure.
Yiğit was always very nice and helpful. The apartment was clean and we felt very welcome. Everything was as described on the pictures.

Confortable and quiet place to stay. No neighbours or street noise. The apartment has 24hrs security, a gym, pool, and a personal small shopping store inside the property. Also, well equipped with pretty much all you need and with shops in the proximity, transportation and a Shopping Mall located at 20min walking distance. Very safe and quiet area, which was nr1 priority for us. The host greeted us upon arrival and was quick to respond to any questions we had.
The only thing is that the TV doesn’t work, and it is not even listed on the listing. So if that’s important for you, you might want to skip this. Also, we asked for another hairdryer since the old one is dying. Should be solved for the next guests.
Overall, will recommend.

Fikirtepe’de olması dezavantaj gibi duruyor ama bina gayet güvenli. Yiğit iletişimi çok iyi bir ev sahibi. Ve gerçekten çok rahat davranmamı sağladı. Salondaki kanepe ge tekli koltuklar değişebilir bence çünkü kullanışlı da rahat da değil. Onun dışında tertemiz bir banyo ve mutfak vardı. Üstelik ne lazımsa yazabiliyorsunuz ev sahibine kolaylıkla. Tekrar tercih ederim
