reviews.text:
Miao was very responsive and helpful (beyond what was related to the accommodation). the apartment is as per the pictures, spacious clean and modern, it's a duplex with 2 bathrooms, so we felt very comfortable. There was a free indoor parking too.
thanks again Miao for everything

Comfortable 2-story flat with nice bedrooms, big windows, and even a balcony. It's located on the last floor so no potentially noisy neighbors above. Fast WiFi was very important for comfortable work. Both bathrooms are good with plenty of storage space, first-need things are also included. The apartment building has trash collection areas on the floor, a gym, and a swimming pool. The location is quite remote, but you can reach the metro station on foot. The nearest mosque makes a lot of noise, especially in the early morning. The host was always available and very responsive.

Miao could easily win the award as best host on Airbnb .She was extremely helpful and accommodated to our needs .She went extra mile to make us feel welcomed, and thanks to that, it even felt as visiting your relatives or even going back to your own home.The place had everything we needed with two small children. Honestly , it was quite a 5-star hotel experience with gym , warm swimming pool, and sauna.The apartment itself is a new , super clean and beautiful .Miao was always available to sory anything we need.f you can walk up and down hill for 10 minutes , you can reach to beautiful Levent area with its malls and metro which takes to touristic Istanbul in no time.We enjoyed call to prayer from nearby mosque too to fully immerse ourselves in Istanbul culture.

Ev ve odalar genişti.
Otopark olması en bonus puandı benim için.
Giriş talimatlarıyla giriş kolay oldu.
Yerler temiz değildi malesef.
Etrafında camı sesi yok demişlerdi, özellikle sormuştum bebeğim var diye. Malesef dibinde camı sesi var, her gün sabah 6da uyandık ses yüzünden.
Tv çalışmıyordu uzaktan yardımcı olamadılar.
Havlular cok kalitesizdi.
Konumu bana göre değildi ama bunu bilerek gittim bütceme uygun diye.
Ev sahibi yardımcısı telefonlarıma cevap verdi hep buda iyidi.
Evin konumu, temizliği fiyat performansa göre çok iyi. Ev sahibi güler yüzlü ve ilgili. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum.

description: Welcome to my designed apartment in the heart of Sisli! Enjoy fascinating Istanbul by staying in my modern and stylish flat. Perfectly located & stylishly designed, this comfortable apartment is suitable for families, larger groups, and longer stays. You will find a great variety of restaurants, cafes, and boutiques at your doorstep. With 3 beds/2 baths, a fully equipped kitchen, and a balcony! It offers a comfortable, clean, and convenient stay.

reviews.text: Umut's was very friendly and helpful landlord. Flat was very clean and safe everything well explained about the check in and out . The flat good located 7 minutes walk to Osman bey station (underground) 15 minutes walk to the mall ( CEVAHIR MALL) . we recommend Umut flat.

it was a great experience. Umut's flat is very clean, modern, neat, more than we can expect. Great location, close to shopping, restaurants, and metro. Recommend to anyone about his place.
Umut was very responsive to all of our question/request. Thanks Umut and his friend Ilkay a lot

It was a memorable stay, our host was very friendly and accomodative of our needs and went beyond his duties to help us. The place was within a walking distance of public transport with plenty of shops around. The furniture were all brand new and the place was super clean.
I would definitely recommend this place.

Umut was very friendly and responsive. The place was super clean and felt like home. He was flexible with the check in and was always making sure that check in and check out were smooth. would definetly recommend.

super location! few minutes walk from beautiful street niśantaši away, cevahercenter within walking distance. to taqsim square you need to walk only 20minutes.
the apartment is very nicely furnished and has everything you need for your stay, modern and chic! would have had a place for strollers on the ground floor, so we did not have to drag it up each time, would have been very grateful. The Umut was always available and very responsible. We were allowed to checkout later because of our baby

description: Nice well-decorated one bedroom 52m2 apartment, all-equipped, inside a secured residence. High speed internet, Live TV application includes worldwide satellite channels, movies, and series. Free parking. Grocery store within the residence. Heating and air-conditioning available. One A/C in the living room and One Fan in the bedroom.

reviews.text:
Great apartment, very clean and we got exactly what was described. Only things that were a slight problem were the heating and WiFi.
The bedroom heater doesn’t turn off even after turning the dial to zero, making the room very warm at night. We compensated this by turning on the A/C as well.
Also the WiFi only worked for a few hours and after that the router didn’t give access to internet for the rest of our stay. This was inconvenient as we only had limited mobile data available as we were traveling from abroad.
When checking out, we were asked to throw away our garbage, but there was no specified location as to where this should be done.
The rest was flawless, it felt like we walked into a hotel room studio and everything was taken care of. The checking out went smoothly and the owner was very friendly and warm. Definitely worth the money as this apartment is conveniently located to amenities and public transport.
Konumu güzel odalar temizdi, aracınızı kapalı veya açık otoparka bırakabilirsiniz. Tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle 🙏🏻

everything was organized and placed in a good way, and I feel very comfortable during the stay I think the only thing you need to replace is the power of the shower and the blanket on the bed sheet that’s the only thing maybe they need to change it but everything else was a good way

Girişte alt otoparka girdim inşaat halindeydi.Duba ile çevrilmiş çukur mevcuttu.Alt otopark çok ürkütücüydü ve asansörü bulmakta zorlandım.Ayrıca asansörler çok pis.Banyo da bulunan ahize sabitleme yeri problemliydi.Tek elimle ahizeyi tutup o şekilde duş almak zorunda kaldım.
Nice place! Good location to grocery shops, 20 mins to Marmara park by foot, good and friendly security. Amal so nice and proactive host, highly recommend this place!

description:
Its unbeatable location puts the best of downtown.

This place is right around the corner of Galata Tower, steps away from Galataport İstanbul, the major subway line, several restaurants, coffee shops and stores. You can be anywhere in downtown in minutes, e.g., Taksim Square, Karaköy.

It is located in a monumental building newly renovated, it oozes style and elegance. Think exposed brick walls and ceilings, arts and slightly offbeat spaces (because why not have a shower in the bedroom?).

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this apartment! It’s recently renovated, very clean and cozy, with a lovely rooftop that offers beautiful views. One of the fun surprises was the elevator that opens directly into the apartment.
The building only has four apartments, which makes it feel very private and intimate. Check-in was super smooth and easy, and I appreciated small touches like having shower gel available.
Although the apartment is located close to Galata Tower, it’s on a quiet side street, and I never heard any noise at night — which was a big plus for me.
As someone with a pet allergy, I was also really grateful that the hosts arranged for me to stay in an apartment where pets are not allowed. They were incredibly kind, flexible, and clearly care a lot about their guests and the experience they provide.
The kitchen had everything I needed — including brand-new dishes, a dishwasher, and a fridge. I would absolutely recommend this place to my friends.

This apartment is in a very cool building, in a very cool neighborhood. Usually, buildings in Beyoglu are walk ups but the elevator for Karay House made it so much easier to enter and exit, as well as move our luggage. The apartment was clean, the amenities were great and the host was super communicative and helpful. The location is excellent, and in walking distance to Galata tower, amazing restaurants and a thriving night life. I highly recommmend this host and this listing!

I was looking for a cosy place to stay during my business trip in Istanbul and the flat exceeded my expectations. The location is amazing; easy to access all routes and public transport, walking distance to Istiklal Street and Galata Port. The style and decoration is very fashionable which I quite enjoyed. Wifi was working great for my international connections. Communication of the host was timely, got all the instructions and felt comfortable before and during the stay. Thank you very much, I'm hoping to be back soon!

Had such a great stay here! The apartment is honestly even better in real life than it looks in the photos: beautiful, comfortable and full of character. The location in Galata is perfect, right in the middle of a really cool part of Istanbul with so much to explore nearby.
Sibil was also incredibly friendly and easy to communicate with, and was kind enough to accommodate both an early check-in and a later check-out, which made our stay so much easier.
Everything felt effortless from start to finish. Would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it!

Thank you Karay House🙏
I had the best experience👌
Their apartment is just steps away from Galata Tower, Galataport and lovely narrow streets of Galata where you can find everything from tiny shops to restaurants and coffee shops💜
There is a shared rooftop terrace with Bosphorus and Galata Tower view🥰
I wish I had more time to enjoy the apartment. It was as well equipped as a luxurious hotel room, the design of the flat and quality of the furnitures and comfort of the bed are amazing🧿
The WiFi is strong, so I could do my calls without having any issues.
The shower in the bedroom was something I have not noticed when booking but loved the idea and experience of jumping from bed to the shower😊
As an Airbnb host and constructor, I may use this idea in my new projects.
Host was very kind and helpful, restaurant and antique shops recommendations were perfect.
I will definitely come back and spend more time🤗

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family. It's on a busy street with grocery stores and restaurants. Very close to public transportation (metro, tram, bus) and within walking distance to Forum Istanbul Shopping Mall. You'll feel at home.

reviews.text: Unfortunately, since this house is on the top floor and there is no elevator.. you will have to walk an incredible amount of stairs.. It can be your worst nightmare in the summer months. There was a heavy smell in the bathroom, since there was no window, we kept the door open and ventilated. the inside of the house is quite normal, the bed, the kitchen, etc., all of them were very good and big. Since there was no air conditioning, it was very hot because it was on the top floor. We slept with the window open all the days we stayed and unfortunately mosquitoes ate us.

Sevcan was very helpful and kind. We spent 3 months in her flat. Once we had problem with the shower but she came immediately and solved the problem. Also, she let us earlier to the flat and let us leave later, so she was very flexible. I absolutely recommend her flat, it was comfortable and clean, like in the pictures.

Very clean place. Sevcan was always quick and helpful in her responses. I really enjoyed the two smaller parks just around the corner. They are really nice and have a lot of possibilities to sit and chill. I often went there to do a bit of sport, they have some training devices, basketball courts and pull up bars there, or just enjoy the good weather. The next metro station is just 10 minutes by foot. The forum mall and Ikea is jus 15-20 minutes by foot. There are also a lot of supermarkets around.

It was a great idea to stay at Sevcan's home. Everything was as described. She and her husband were so friendly. The location is really helpful, because the flat is surrounded by many supermarkets and restaurants. I would highly recommend staying at this place 😊

Sevcan Hanım'a çok teşekkür ederim. Ev gerçekten çok temizdi. Kendi evimizde gibi hissettik. 3 kişi beraber konakladık. Çevrede birçok restorant mevcut, yakınlarda yürüyüş yapabileceğiniz çok temiz bir park var. Metroya yürüyerek 3-5 dakika içinde rahatça ulaşabilirsiniz. Yakınlarda minibüs ve otobüsler geçiyor. ATM'ler çevrede bulunuyor. Döviz büroları yakınlarda bulunuyor.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. As the Semt Istanbul family, we offer you a special accommodation experience. This apartment is a new apartment furnished in a modern style with 1 room, open kitchen, 1 living room, 1 bathroom. All kitchen utensils, filter coffee machine, fridge, washing machine, iron and ironing board are available. Our apartment is located in Karaköy, opposite Galataport, in a special area where restaurants are famous and you can visit historical places

reviews.text: Fatih was very responsive and allowed me to check in early. The place was very clean and comfortable but kitchen and living room as well as bathroom are much smaller than appears in photos so up to a couple can be here comfortably. Rare elevator in building safes you from hauling luggage up stairs several floors up. Fantastic location with tram three minutes away and lots of cafes, restaurants, port boardwalk, live music, and shopping steps away. The fernicular up to Galata is 8 minutes’ walk and fresh fish on shore just ten minutes away. Only thing that could be better was more than just the one roll of toilet paper already in bathroom for guests staying more than two nights and some extra hand soap. Overall, highly recommend this place!

Great apartment with great location! The lift was a bonus. Very comfy bed and comfy couch! Really good fridge and big TV but with all the sounding landmarks we barely used it. Good little bathroom with hot water whenever we needed it! Large bedroom with great black blinds. Felt secure and had a good time. Plenty of restaurants nearby. (Did not need Aircon due to the month we visited... But did not spot any Aircon in the apartment). Love from the UK.

I had a really disappointing stay. The AC barely worked, even after it was supposedly fixed—it was uncomfortable the entire time. The WiFi cut out while I was trying to work, which was incredibly frustrating. When I arrived, the bedsheets were visibly dirty, and I had to wash them myself right away. The showerhead wouldn’t stay in place and kept falling, making it hard to use. The iron was already damaged with a burn stain and ended up ruining one of my shirts. I initially tried to communicate these issues, but eventually stopped because I was just too frustrated. Would not recommend staying here.

We had a great 4 days stay at Fatih’s place in early October. Apartment is on the highest 4th floor so, existing elevator is a big plus. Living room/ kitchen area is quite small but enough for 2 people. Apartment is located on very narrow street which is difficult to navigate in a car but easy on foot, with many restaurants, cafes, bars and even street food. Superb location, only 3 minutes walk to the tram T1 stop called Tophane. 10 minutes walk to Galata Tower (steep uphill) or Galata bridge and ferry port (mostly flat).
Would easily stay there again. Thanks Fatih and best regards

There is no words can describe how beautiful, comfortable and warm the place is! we had a great time staying at this lovely apartment which was in great location close to all best places in Istanbul! Also, Fatih was a great host who kept checking on us and see if we needed anything. We will definitely recommend this place to our friends and we will definitely come back again.

description:
Its unbeatable location puts the best of downtown.
This place is right around the corner of Galata Tower, steps away from Galataport İstanbul, the major subway line, several restaurants, coffee shops and stores. You can be anywhere in downtown in minutes, e.g., Taksim Square, Karaköy etc.
It is a monumental building newly renovated, it oozes style and elegance. Think exposed brick walls and ceilings, arts and slightly offbeat spaces (because why not have a shower in the bedroom?).

reviews.text: Erdinc’s property is amazing and met our needs for a group of 8. Each apartment is spacious and the elevator helps a lot with taking luggage. The location is fantastic with walkable restaurants, shops etc. The host was great and very responsive especially when we accidentally locked ourselves out, she came within minutes to unlock us. Overall amazing stay, the rooftop view is the cherry on top

Sibel was a great host and the place was perfect for the size of group that we had. She was attentive to our needs and quick to respond.
This place is top notch it such a wonderful neighbourhood.
The *only* reason I gave 4/5 stars overall was because the AC didn’t work in the living rooms on a few of the floors and with the heat wave, it was hot to say the least. Sibel was very attentive and did her best to get them repaired on short notice, which is always nice to see. I’m sure it’s an easy fix for the next tenants. I would stay there again in a heart beat.

Really beautiful apartments, the interior is nice and everything was really clean. The area was very convenient to walk anywhere :)
The communication with the host was really good and fast. All in all super 👌🏼

We loved Karay’s House! It was perfect for our group of 5 ladies. We each had our own private apartment- all were Very clean
The location is perfect! Easy to walk to restaurants and shops Highly recommended
Perfect accomendation, located close to Galata Tower and not too far off Galatabridge, which is superb equipped. Easy going communication and very helpful and proactive support.

description:
The flat is a modern renovation of a historical 18th century Istanbul building. The Pera region in the Beyoglu district of Istanbul is culturally significant; It is home to numerous galleries, bars, hotels and restaurants like the Pera Museum, Salt Art Gallery, Pera Palace Hotel and Soho House.
The flat is in the heart of Istanbul, 100 meters from Canir Istiklal Avenue, with restaurants and other cultural venues within a short walking distance.

reviews.text:
Amazing Stay in Istanbul!
We were three people staying at Necat’s apartment, and everything was perfect! The place is nice, very clean, and beautifully decorated — exactly like the photos, maybe even better. All the household tools and amenities were in excellent condition, which made our stay very comfortable.
The location is great, just a short walk from Galata Tower and close to many restaurants, shops, and public transport options — perfect for exploring Istanbul.
Necat was extremely helpful and friendly, always available whenever we needed something. His hospitality made our stay even better.
We truly enjoyed our time here and will definitely come back again on our next visit to Istanbul. Highly recommended!

I booked this Airbnb pretty last minute, and overall I can say it was a pretty great value for the price. The location is excellent, very walkable and close to all public transportation. The hosts were also incredibly responsive, any questions I had they answered back within minutes. The apartment is located on the first floor so you will hear people entering and leaving the building, it is an old building and there was a good deal of noise from the upstairs neighbors but it wasn’t an issue for us since we were out of the apartment for most of the day (definitely bring some earplugs if it will bother you). Overall we enjoyed our stay here, it was the perfect size apartment for two people and much roomier than if we had booked a hotel room.

Necate is a great host. he waited me 2hrs for check in!
the appt has very comfortable beds!
the location was in an old neighborhood and and in an old building. but it is very close from everything.
very clean apartment, a bit humid. but worth 100% the money.

Good location, very close to the tram stop, Galata port and Galata tower and min.10 walk to Istiklal but uphill. The apartment is equipped with all the necessary amenities for 4 people and a small kitchen. The apartment was super clean, everything was perfect. no complaints at all. Also, the hosts were super nice and kind, they answered every questions we had.
The noise from the street enters into living room, which is a bit noisy during weekends.

The apartment is like on the photos, at the ground floor, but reasonably quiet, on a very small sidestreet. The main street is commercial, with several great food shops very near the place. The street is narrow and the buildings are rather tall, so that the apartment is dark, one needs electric light even on a sunny day. We could not find some useful items, for example a kitchen towel, but I think Necat would have brought them if we asked (we only came for a couple of days, so we did not). He is a nice and friendly host, who probably does not speak foreign languages, but the communication is good with the automatic translator. Overall, we are satisfied and thankful.

description:
This 2BR apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

- Designed with taste, this apartment will be ideal for anyone who is seeking comfort, a “home like” atmosphere, accessibility to major tourist attractions.

-Self check-in is also available using the password
-The sofa is prepared for the 5th person.

reviews.text: evin konumu çok iyiydi ev düzenli ve temizdi fotoğraflardaki gibiydi ev geniş ve ferahtı iletişim çok hızlıydı verdikleri hizmet fiyatı karşılıyor çok memnun kaldık

İclal hanım ilgiliydi. Ev fotoğraflarla eş değerdi diyebilirim. Konum açısından güzeldi. Fiyat performans denecek kadar iyiydi. Teras çok kullanışlıydı. Güvenilir ve temiz bir evdi. Fenerbahçe stadının hemen yanında. Özellikle bu konumda kalacak kişilerin tutabileceği güzel bir ev. İlgilerine teşekkür ederim.

The apartment had only one air conditioner for the entire space, including the kitchen and lounge, so we had to leave the doors open to keep both rooms cool. For this reason alone, I consider the property a bit overpriced. Despite this issue, everything else met our expectations, and the hosts were incredibly responsive. However, it's worth noting that some amenities are not readily available and need to be requested at the reception during working hours.
Konumu harika, temiz bir ev. Ev sahibi tüm mesajlarıma hemen yanıt verdi ve iletişimi samimiydi. Keyifli bir bölge. Tekrar kalmam gerekirse mutlaka burayı tercih ederim.

We really enjoyed our stay here. The property was as shown in the photos, the location was great with good transport links but also in a quiet road and finally the staff were always at hand to help when needed. I strongly recommend this place for anybody who wants to stay in Istanbul.

description: Your own private studio with a balcony and beautiful sunset views in the heart of Kadıköy. Enjoy the privacy of your own space, plus access to Nest’s coworking areas, shared spaces and 500+ Mbps WiFi. Spend the day working, explore Kadıköy’s cafés and streets, then come home to your own balcony as the sun goes down. A comfortable base for travelers and digital nomads, with an international community around you.

reviews.text:
Everything was okay. I was a bit disturbed by the traffic noise because I sleep with the open window but after 2 days I could move to another room on the quieter side of the apartment. Bed a little small for normal sized folks. Big common living room to relax. Public areas cleaned daily.
This is an apartment that has been (hastily?) subdivided into small rooms. Everything worked (washing machine, kitchen, shower etc.) but things look very simple and old (fridge) and a bit like an unfinished construction side (door frames, lamps). Simple quality bed and furniture.
The value for money is still excellent given the modest rate I payed.
Overall impression: The onside manager and especially excellent super-friendly cleaning lady (Olga) make up for the penny-pinching owners.

Nice stay for the price. It's in a good location you can walk anywhere. Shared spaces were reasonably clean and other guests were kind and respectful. Host was kind, though slow to respond at times. I would definitely stay here again. Thanks.

The hostel's location was excellent, with easy access to Kadikoy, great cafe and eatery around, although a little noisy.
Check-in/out was smooth, and the staff assisted me with some luggage storage.
The common area had a good vibe, though the bathrooms were often unclean, and the kitchen was messy due to renovations. Additionally I requested a fan which was listed as an amenity but never received it.
Despite these issues, I see great potential in the place and wish them all the best.

Amazing location and great working space. Room was so hot and a fan would have been a great addition. Water all over the entrance way and a foul smell in the entry alley. A good love for a nomad who doesn’t mind too much about the room
The airbnb had a great location. The host was very responsive and tried to help me as much as she can. The room and the kitchen/bathroom were clean overall. Would definitely recommend.

description: We have a apartment 3 rooms one kitchen , 2 bathroom and 2 toilet. Enjoy🌿🕊

reviews.text: this my first time using airbnb. even through we havent met ozgur. he seems a nice person, fast response. he even yelp us to book airport transport (van mercedes fit up to 5 person include luggage) and cost 40 euro. the place walking distance to galata tower. and near to convenience store (SOK). all kitchen equipment are complete as per described. will stay here again
Great location, walkable to local bars and restaurants, clean apartment with two showers which was helpful for our larger group.

We enjoyed our stay at Stay Galata 1. The apartment is very comfortable and spacious, and it has everything you can ask for.
The apartment is very close to Galata tower and has a lot of restaurants and shops around, you could not ask for a better location.
The host is very responsive and helpful, I would stay here again for sure.
The bathroom does have a funny smell, but this is probably the drains of the old part of the city, I don't think this is something that can be controlled by the host. If you are very fussy about smells, you will probably not going to enjoy staying here.
Thanks Ozgur!

Beautiful apartment that's walkable to just about everything you'd want to see. (Indeed, I walked everywhere.) The beds were super comfortable, the kitchen and bathroom were stocked with everything we needed (and then some), and Derya was incredibly responsive and communicative; I couldn't have asked for anything more.
In terms of sleeping, if you need or prefer a dark room, I'd recommend bringing an eye mask as the street lights are bright. Similarly, the trade-off to being in the heart of everything is that there's a good deal of car traffic (think taxis and restaurant deliveries on a narrow street). Earplugs were thoughtfully provided, but I ended up using the noise cancellation function on my AirPods.
I would absolutely stay here again. If you stay here, visit Frida House Cafe just up the street.

Overall place is good from location perspective. very Close and walkable to Galata tower and other locations.
But a bit old so basic things can be improved.
eg: atleast 1 plug point in rooms -not available. Lamps in room not working etc.
Hot water want working.
But the owner/property handler was super prompt to provide the fix for hot water by sending the house keeper.
Very prompt and clear communication.

description: Enjoy a stylish and spacious experience in the heart of Istanbul. Situated on a quiet street in a historic neighbourhood 3-min walk from the famous Istiklal Avenue shopping district. The close by Taksim Square metro line ensures you easy access to the all city’s attractions, making it easy to get around both by foot and local transport. Whether you want to delve into the city's rich history or enjoy a multitude of restaurants, this flat is an ideal starting point having it all around the corner.

reviews.text:
Benny is very helpful and friendly Host. the space was clean and tidy. kitchen tools was enough for 3 Adult.
the bed was small for two people but another bed in basement was okay for person. anyways, everything was close and we enjoyed just ten minutes walk to Taksim, restaurants and shopping center.
Thank you Benny

Benny is an excellent host that got up at 6am to welcome me and have me come in as my flight was cancelled and changed last minute.
The house was very clean and set up with many towels and even little slippers like a spa. It all felt very welcoming and high end. A great feeling after a terrible flight situation.
The house itself was very cool and the light fixtures were awesome giving you a funky feel contrasting the classic Turkish streets outside.
The location is a super short walk from the main road and across the hustle and bustle of the touristic area. You need a short walk to get to Pera Museum and that whole beautiful architecture of old Istanbul and a little bit to get to the high street shopping Taksim and Istiklal.
Over all, a wonderful stay, comfortable and calm with the madness of Istanbul on the outside when you want.

Benny’s place is all what we were looking for! The place itself looks exactly like the photos and the location couldn’t be better! All clean, tidy, comfortable and well maintained. We would recommend it to anyone! If ever back, we’d stay here again!

The apartment is nice, the main bed is very comfortable, the kitchen has everything you need, the living room is on the first floor, has a TV, large furniture and has very nice decorations, it also has a large patio where you can relax, near the house there are many places to buy what you need, the host is a very kind person, always willing to help you with whatever you need during your stay.

Benny's place is perfect to visit Istanbul. Great location, near bars and restaurants and easy to get to/from the main touristic areas of the city. The apartment itself is also great. Very clean, organized and practical. Just like the photos and the description.
